tools.name: PLACER
tools.usage: PLACER is a geometric deep learning framework developed by the Baker Laboratory for rapid and accurate local prediction of protein-ligand conformational ensembles and binding pose distributions.
tools.strengths: Fast inference with realistic ensemble diversity capturing binding site plasticity.
tools.weaknesses: Requires pre-localized binding pocket definition.

tools.name: PPIFlow
tools.usage: PPIFlow is a continuous geometric flow matching model for de novo generation of high-affinity protein binders, achieving continuous SE(3) trajectory sampling for complex interfaces.
tools.strengths: Superior generation throughput and interface contact geometry.
tools.weaknesses: High GPU memory consumption during long target-binder generation runs.

tools.name: ConformFlow
tools.usage: ConformFlow utilizes latent normalizing flows to map and sample continuous protein conformational landscapes, generating statistically rigorous structural ensembles directly comparable to MD and NMR.
tools.strengths: Statistically exact density estimation with instant sampling of multi-state ensembles.
tools.weaknesses: Requires initial multi-state structural seed representations.

tools.name: Proteo-R1
tools.usage: Proteo-R1 is an open-source reasoning foundation model trained via large-scale reinforcement learning for multi-step logical reasoning in protein engineering, structural analysis, and drug design.
tools.strengths: Deep reasoning capabilities that bridge natural language with biomolecular structure data.
tools.weaknesses: Inference latency is higher than standard non-reasoning LLMs.

tools.name: DiffModeler
tools.usage: DiffModeler is a deep diffusion framework from the Kihara Lab designed for automated atomic model building and assembly of multi-chain protein complexes from intermediate-resolution cryo-EM density maps.
tools.strengths: Excels on challenging 4-8 Å intermediate-resolution cryo-EM maps where classical tools fail.
tools.weaknesses: Computationally demanding for very large virus-scale or megadalton complexes.

tools.name: AbX
tools.usage: AbX is an open-source score-based diffusion model for de novo antibody design and CDR loop optimization guided by evolutionary sequence conservation, physical energies, and 3D geometric constraints.
tools.strengths: Generates antibodies with high predicted developability, stability, and antigen complementarity.
tools.weaknesses: Requires target antigen 3D coordinate input.

tools.name: AlphaPPImd
tools.usage: AlphaPPImd couples generative transformer architectures with OpenMM molecular dynamics simulations to sample conformational ensembles and binding pathways of protein-protein complexes.
tools.strengths: Bridges machine learning predictions with rigorous atomistic physics and thermodynamics.
tools.weaknesses: Requires CUDA-compatible GPU for OpenMM MD refinement steps.

tools.name: IDPFold
tools.usage: IDPFold is a deep learning system specifically designed to generate realistic, diverse conformational ensembles for intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) and disordered regions (IDRs), matching SAXS and NMR data.
tools.strengths: Accurate statistical mechanics description of disorder without multimillion-step atomistic MD.
tools.weaknesses: Optimized primarily for disordered regions rather than rigid globular domains.

tools.name: Dyno Psi-1 (dynopsi)
tools.usage: Dyno Psi-1 is an open-source inference and sampling engine released by Dyno Therapeutics for de novo generative design of high-affinity miniprotein binders against therapeutic targets.
tools.strengths: Fast generation of highly expressing, thermostable miniprotein binders.
tools.weaknesses: Focused primarily on miniprotein binder formats (40-90 residues).

tools.name: nf-binder-design
tools.usage: nf-binder-design is a production-ready Nextflow pipeline developed by the Australian Protein Design Initiative integrating RFdiffusion, ProteinMPNN, ESMFold, and BindCraft for automated HPC binder screening.
tools.strengths: Turn-key deployment on high-performance computing clusters with complete reproducibility.
tools.weaknesses: Requires Nextflow runtime and Apptainer/Docker container backend.

tools.name: ProtenixScore
tools.usage: ProtenixScore is a lightweight utility that evaluates and scores existing PDB and mmCIF protein structures using the Protenix confidence head directly, eliminating the need to run costly diffusion steps.
tools.strengths: Blazing fast structure assessment without recomputing full structural diffusion.
tools.weaknesses: Does not perform coordinate refinement or relaxation.

tools.name: BioInterface
tools.usage: BioInterface is a Python framework built on Biopython for extracting, categorizing, and quantifying Protein-DNA and Protein-RNA interaction interfaces from AlphaFold 3 and experimental PDB structures.
tools.strengths: Clean, Pythonic API tailored specifically for protein-nucleic acid interface geometry.
tools.weaknesses: Focused primarily on interface contact extraction rather than de novo design.

tools.name: E3_Ligome
tools.usage: E3_Ligome is an integrated database and code resource classifying the human E3 ligome by combining AlphaFold structural models, domain architectures, binding pockets, and deep metric learning.
tools.strengths: Vital resource for targeted protein degradation and molecular glue discovery.
tools.weaknesses: Specific to E3 ubiquitin ligase families.

tools.name: ProteinBind
tools.usage: ProteinBind is a modular platform hosted on GitLab for automated macromolecular structure preparation, pocket detection, flexible docking, and binding interaction profiling.
tools.strengths: Streamlined setup for academic and virtual screening workflows.
tools.weaknesses: Classical force field scoring compared to end-to-end co-folding.

tools.name: RFdiffusion Complex & Multi-Chain Foundation Weights on HuggingFace
tools.usage: Community release of pre-trained model weights for RFdiffusion complex and multi-chain backbone generation hosted on the HuggingFace Hub in modern safetensors format.
tools.strengths: Standardizes RFdiffusion model distribution on open ML hubs.
tools.weaknesses: Requires full RFdiffusion environment for sampling scripts.

tools.name: RFdiffusion3 Interactive Web Space
tools.usage: Interactive Gradio Space on HuggingFace offering an accessible web interface for running de novo protein design, motif scaffolding, and binder generation without local GPU installation.
tools.strengths: Immediate accessibility in web browsers on desktop and mobile devices.
tools.weaknesses: Queue times on free HuggingFace hardware tiers for large designs.

tools.name: Proteus Flow Matching
tools.usage: Proteus Flow Matching is an SE(3)-equivariant continuous flow model for rapid protein backbone generation released on HuggingFace with open MIT license.
tools.strengths: Fast trajectory generation with low computational overhead.
tools.weaknesses: Generates backbone coordinates; requires downstream sequence design (e.g. ProteinMPNN).

tools.name: Comparative Benchmark of Co-Folding Methods for Molecular Glue Ternary Complexes
tools.usage: Published in the Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling, this systematic study benchmarks AlphaFold 3, Boltz-1, and Chai-1 on predicting target-ligand-E3 ligase ternary complex structures.
tools.strengths: Essential benchmark dataset for targeted protein degradation and molecular glue discovery.
tools.weaknesses: Benchmark dataset size constrained by available experimental ternary co-crystal structures.

tools.name: Survey & Benchmark of Deep Learning Methods for Cryo-EM Atomic Model Building
tools.usage: Comprehensive review and standardized benchmark published in Briefings in Bioinformatics evaluating state-of-the-art deep learning methods for atomic model building from cryo-EM density maps.
tools.strengths: Definitive comparative reference for deep learning cryo-EM practitioners.
tools.weaknesses: Examines map-to-model tools; does not cover upstream particle picking or 3D reconstruction.

tools.name: Structure-Factory
tools.usage: Structure-Factory is an AI-agent toolkit designed for structural biology and drug discovery. It autonomously coordinates binder design, protein structure prediction, candidate screening, ranking, and cloud-scale execution across GPU clusters.
tools.strengths: Enables zero-friction automation for large-scale de novo binder screening campaigns.
tools.weaknesses: Requires cloud API keys or local GPU infrastructure for heavy model backends.

tools.name: MICA
tools.usage: MICA (Multimodal Integration for Cryo-EM with AlphaFold) from the Jianlin Cheng Lab integrates experimental cryo-EM density maps with AlphaFold 3 predictions to achieve high-accuracy atomic structure determination of challenging macromolecular complexes.
tools.strengths: Combines physical experimental data constraints with state-of-the-art AI co-folding accuracy.
tools.weaknesses: Requires 3D cryo-EM density maps and corresponding sequence inputs.

tools.name: PreStoi
tools.usage: PreStoi is a deep learning framework developed by the Cheng Lab for predicting the exact oligomeric state and stoichiometry of protein complexes using AlphaFold 3 interaction matrices and structural templates.
tools.strengths: Solves the fundamental multimer stoichiometry guessing bottleneck in structural biology.
tools.weaknesses: Computational scaling increases with higher combinatorial multimer states.

tools.name: boltz_dap
tools.usage: boltz_dap implements Distributed Axial Parallelism (DAP) and FlexAttention kernel acceleration for Boltz-2 and AlphaFold 3-style architectures, completely preventing Out-Of-Memory (OOM) errors during large complex inference.
tools.strengths: Dramatically lowers GPU VRAM requirements and enables ultra-large complex prediction.
tools.weaknesses: Requires multi-GPU hardware or PyTorch nightly for full FlexAttention acceleration.

tools.name: protein.cpp
tools.usage: protein.cpp is a pure C++/GGML high-performance inference engine for ESMF and ESM-C protein foundation models, providing lightweight, ultra-fast embedding extraction and sequence modeling on CPU and GPU.
tools.strengths: Extreme inference speed with minimal memory footprint; eliminates Python/PyTorch dependencies.
tools.weaknesses: Focuses on protein representation and embedding generation rather than 3D coordinate diffusion.

tools.name: chimerax-alphafold-mcp
tools.usage: chimerax-alphafold-mcp is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enabling AI coding agents (Antigravity IDE, Claude, Cursor) to control UCSF ChimeraX for automated AlphaFold structure retrieval, superposition, and pLDDT visualization.
tools.strengths: Direct bridge between agentic AI assistants and professional structural biology visualization.
tools.weaknesses: Requires a local installation of UCSF ChimeraX.

tools.name: ProCEDiS
tools.usage: ProCEDiS is a state-annotation-free computational framework to generate compact, diverse protein conformational ensembles by combining MSA recombination, AlphaFold 2, and short molecular dynamics relaxations.
tools.strengths: High sampling efficiency and coverage of known cryo-EM and NMR multi-state conformations.
tools.weaknesses: Requires OpenMM or GROMACS backend for the MD relaxation phase.

tools.name: boltz2-hpc-tools
tools.usage: boltz2-hpc-tools is an open-source workflow and utility suite by Greenstone Biosciences for high-throughput screening and automated job distribution of Boltz-2 biomolecular predictions across HPC SLURM clusters.
tools.strengths: Streamlines institutional HPC deployment for massive protein-ligand and protein-protein screening.
tools.weaknesses: Designed primarily for SLURM cluster environments.

tools.name: Geom-Diffusion-Guidance
tools.usage: Geom-Diffusion-Guidance provides structure-based molecular generative diffusion with explicit geometric classifier guidance derived from protein sidechain interactions to direct ligand generation into target binding pockets.
tools.strengths: Direct control over pharmacophore interactions during generative diffusion.
tools.weaknesses: Requires identification of key anchor residue coordinates.

tools.name: esm-msr
tools.usage: esm-msr is a deep learning framework that predicts and visualizes (multi-)mutant protein thermodynamic stability ($\Delta\Delta G$) via parameter-efficient fine-tuning of ESM3 foundation representations.
tools.strengths: Outperforms classical physics scoring (FoldX, Rosetta) on high-order epistatic mutant variants.
tools.weaknesses: Optimized primarily for stability ($\Delta\Delta G$) rather than binding kinetics.

tools.name: BindCraftAA
tools.usage: BindCraftAA extends the BindCraft automated design paradigm to all-atom precision, integrating open all-atom models (Boltz-1) to design protein binders against complex target surfaces, cofactors, and ligands.
tools.strengths: Fully open-weights all-atom binder design stack with high experimental hit rates.
tools.weaknesses: Requires CUDA GPU with >=16GB VRAM for full all-atom validation steps.

tools.name: BinderRanker
tools.usage: BinderRanker provides an interpretable multi-stage ranking and layered screening framework for filtering massive generated protein backbone libraries from RFdiffusion, BindCraft, and BoltzGen.
tools.strengths: Dramatically reduces wet-lab testing costs by prioritizing the most developable binder candidates.
tools.weaknesses: Focuses on candidate triage rather than de novo generation itself.

tools.name: MMProtRepPPI
tools.usage: MMProtRepPPI is an open-source multimodal representation learning framework that unifies 1D amino acid sequence representations with 3D structural graphs to predict protein-protein interaction networks and binding interfaces.
tools.strengths: Superior generalization across divergent protein families lacking close structural homologs.
tools.weaknesses: Pre-training requires paired sequence and structural coordinate datasets.

tools.name: dense-arrays
tools.usage: dense-arrays is a computational design library developed by the Dunlop Lab for engineering double-stranded DNA promoter sequences packed with dense, overlapping DNA-protein binding sites and regulatory operator arrays.
tools.strengths: Unique focus on multi-protein binding site packing on nucleic acid scaffolds.
tools.weaknesses: Focuses on regulatory nucleic acid sequence design rather than all-atom protein folding.

tools.name: DeepProteinDesign
tools.usage: DeepProteinDesign is a deep learning suite developed at Institut Pasteur utilizing continuous latent-space Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) for generative protein sequence exploration and functional fold optimization.
tools.strengths: Fast generation of functionally constrained sequence variants from learned latent distributions.
tools.weaknesses: Requires substantial sequence family alignments for training specific protein targets.

tools.name: Haruspex
tools.usage: Haruspex is a 3D convolutional deep neural network trained to recognize and segment protein secondary structure elements ($lpha$-helices, $ eta$-sheets) and RNA/DNA nucleotides directly from intermediate-resolution cryo-EM density maps.
tools.strengths: High segmentation accuracy that simplifies initial atomic model tracing in complex densities.
tools.weaknesses: Provides secondary structure segmentations rather than full all-atom coordinates.

tools.name: PPI Benchmark Database
tools.usage: PPI Benchmark Database is an interactive query and benchmarking database built on Docking Benchmark v5.5, designed for systematic evaluation of AlphaFold-Multimer, Boltz-1, and Chai-1 protein docking accuracy.
tools.strengths: Essential benchmark resource for testing new ML docking and co-folding algorithms.
tools.weaknesses: Focuses on binary protein-protein complexes; does not include multi-chain nucleic acids.

tools.name: Cryo-EM Ensemble Reweighting
tools.usage: Cryo-EM Ensemble Reweighting is an open-source framework using maximum entropy and Bayesian reweighting to align AlphaFold-generated conformational ensembles with experimental single-particle cryo-EM images.
tools.strengths: Directly reconciles computational AI conformational predictions with experimental cryo-EM data.
tools.weaknesses: Requires access to unaligned or class-averaged cryo-EM particle stacks.

tools.name: Protenix-Base
tools.usage: Protenix-Base is ByteDance AI Lab's open-weights model checkpoint released on HuggingFace Hub for all-atom biomolecular complex structure prediction spanning proteins, RNA, DNA, ligands, and ions.
tools.strengths: Zero licensing barriers for commercial and academic structural biology pipelines.
tools.weaknesses: Requires CUDA GPU with >=16GB VRAM for large complex inference.

tools.name: PRISM-Antibody
tools.usage: PRISM-Antibody is a specialized protein language model developed by the Romero Lab at Duke University, fine-tuned on diverse antibody repertoires for high-accuracy prediction of antigen binding, stability, and developability.
tools.strengths: Fast zero-shot screening of massive therapeutic antibody variant libraries.
tools.weaknesses: Focuses on sequence-level fitness and developability scoring.

tools.name: knots_protbertBFD_alphafold
tools.usage: knots_protbertBFD_alphafold is a transformer-based classification model trained to identify topological knots, slipknots, and self-entanglements in AlphaFold-predicted protein structures.
tools.strengths: Rapid detection of structural anomalies and knotted folds without full polynomial knot calculation.
tools.weaknesses: Trained on knot classifications; does not compute explicit Alexander polynomials.

tools.name: OpenDDE Structure Prediction
tools.usage: OpenDDE Structure Prediction is an interactive Gradio web space on HuggingFace Hub by Aureka Research providing zero-install structure prediction and continuous conformational landscape exploration.
tools.strengths: User-friendly web access for wet-lab biologists to explore protein conformational dynamics.
tools.weaknesses: Subject to HuggingFace public Space compute queue limits.

tools.name: BioPrime Molecular Docking
tools.usage: BioPrime Molecular Docking is an interactive HuggingFace Space enabling rapid structure-based deep learning molecular docking and binding pose evaluation for small-molecule drug candidates.
tools.strengths: Zero-friction ligand docking accessible from any web browser.
tools.weaknesses: Optimized for single-ligand interactive screening rather than million-compound virtual screening.

tools.name: Antibody Predictor
tools.usage: Antibody Predictor is a HuggingFace Space dedicated to interactive antibody CDR loop structure prediction, antigen-antibody docking, and interface complementarity scoring.
tools.strengths: Fast turn-around for antibody engineering and candidate optimization.
tools.weaknesses: Best suited for standard IgG and Fab antibody formats.

tools.name: GB.StructurePrediction
tools.usage: GB.StructurePrediction is an open biomolecular structure foundation model released by GenBio AI on HuggingFace Hub, offering accelerated 3D structure generation from protein sequences.
tools.strengths: High generation throughput suitable for massive proteome-scale annotation.
tools.weaknesses: Emerging release; documentation and ecosystem adapters under active development.

tools.name: Boltz-2 PyTorch - Open PyTorch Implementation of Boltz-2 All-Atom Predictor
tools.usage: An open PyTorch reproduction of the Boltz-2 all-atom biomolecular modeling architecture, featuring fast distilled diffusion inference for proteins, nucleic acids, and small molecules.
tools.strengths: Fast inference throughput and accessible open-source PyTorch codebase.
tools.weaknesses: Requires GPU with >= 24GB VRAM for large multimers.

tools.name: protein-frame-flow - SE(3) Equivariant Flow Matching for Protein Backbone Generation
tools.usage: Developed by Microsoft Research, protein-frame-flow implements Riemannian flow matching on SE(3) coordinate frames for ultra-fast and topologically diverse protein backbone generation.
tools.strengths: Superior generation speed and sampling efficiency compared to score-based diffusion models.
tools.weaknesses: Generates backbone frames only; requires downstream inverse folding for sequence assignment.

tools.name: DiffMD - Generative Learning for Molecular Dynamics with Diffusion Models
tools.usage: DiffMD is a deep generative framework developed by Microsoft Research for simulating and sampling protein molecular dynamics trajectories and transition states directly using diffusion models.
tools.strengths: Orders-of-magnitude acceleration in sampling rare conformational transitions.
tools.weaknesses: Requires pre-computed MD trajectory datasets for domain-specific fine-tuning.

tools.name: OpenFold 3 - Community Implementation of All-Atom AlphaFold 3 Architecture
tools.usage: OpenFold 3 is the open community implementation of DeepMind's AlphaFold 3 all-atom architecture, supporting end-to-end training and inference on multi-entity biomolecular complexes.
tools.strengths: Full transparency into model architecture and custom training routines.
tools.weaknesses: Active community development; weights training ongoing across distributed consortia.

tools.name: P2DFlow - Protein Ensemble Generative Model with SE(3) Flow Matching
tools.usage: P2DFlow is a geometric deep learning generative model formulating protein conformational ensemble prediction as an optimal transport Riemannian flow matching problem on SE(3) manifolds.
tools.strengths: High sampling efficiency and faithful representation of free-energy minima.
tools.weaknesses: Requires initial structural anchor coordinates.

tools.name: ProteinZen - All-Atom Generative Protein Design via SE(3) Flow Matching
tools.usage: ProteinZen is an all-atom generative protein design model combining continuous SE(3) flow matching on backbones with discrete sequence and sidechain generation in a unified architecture.
tools.strengths: Single-step generation of designable sequence-structure pairs.
tools.weaknesses: Higher memory consumption during long multi-chain generation.

tools.name: PocketFlow - Generalized Protein Pocket Generation with Prior-Informed Flow Matching
tools.usage: PocketFlow (NeurIPS 2024) is a prior-informed Riemannian flow matching model for designing target-specific, druggable protein binding pockets tailored to complex small-molecule scaffolds.
tools.strengths: Fast de novo binding pocket generation for targeted covalent and non-covalent ligands.
tools.weaknesses: Generated pockets must be scaffolded into globular protein folds for wet-lab expression.

tools.name: CoCoFold - Fine-Tuning AlphaFold with Cryo-EM Observations for Experimental Refinement
tools.usage: CoCoFold integrates experimental Cryo-EM density maps into AlphaFold fine-tuning loops to resolve alternative conformational states and resolve flexible loop regions.
tools.strengths: Bridges deep learning structural priors with physical experimental measurements.
tools.weaknesses: Performance depends on the resolution and signal-to-noise ratio of Cryo-EM volumes.

tools.name: DeepChain - In Silico Antibody Engineering & Protein Design Workflow on GitLab
tools.usage: DeepChain on GitLab is a modular computational platform for in silico therapeutic antibody engineering, CDR optimization, and deep learning-guided protein stability optimization.
tools.strengths: Modular containerized workflows suitable for automated GitLab CI/CD pipelines.
tools.weaknesses: Requires external structural coordinates for complex interface calculations.

tools.name: AlphaFlow-Snakemake - High-Throughput AlphaFold Modeling & Validation Pipeline
tools.usage: AlphaFlow is a reproducible Snakemake workflow for high-throughput batch AlphaFold structure prediction, multi-state MSA subsampling, quality assessment, and structural clustering.
tools.strengths: Production-grade Snakemake pipeline designed for large-scale structural genomics batches.
tools.weaknesses: Relies on standard AF2 MSA preprocessing overhead.

tools.name: SBGrid-AlphaFold2 - Deployment Recipes & High-Performance HPC Workflows
tools.usage: SBGrid-AlphaFold2 provides standardized containerized recipes, SLURM scheduler integration, and optimized CUDA builds for deploying AlphaFold and ColabFold across institutional HPC clusters.
tools.strengths: Extremely robust deployment standard trusted by structural biology cores worldwide.
tools.weaknesses: Focuses on deployment automation rather than novel prediction algorithms.

tools.name: af2-complex - Automated Protein-Protein Interaction Screening Pipeline
tools.usage: af2-complex is an automated computational pipeline for proteome-wide protein-protein interaction (PPI) screening and multimeric complex modeling using AlphaFold-Multimer.
tools.strengths: Streamlined execution of hundreds of binary and higher-order complex co-folds.
tools.weaknesses: Computationally intensive for large multi-subunit complexes (> 3 chains).

tools.name: cryoem-refine - Nextflow Pipeline for AlphaFold Integration with Cryo-EM Maps
tools.usage: cryoem-refine is a Nextflow workflow for automated docking, rigid-body fitting, and real-space refinement of AlphaFold-predicted structures into Cryo-EM density volumes.
tools.strengths: Fully reproducible end-to-end atomic model building pipeline for Cryo-EM facilities.
tools.weaknesses: Depends on Phenix / ISOLDE software licenses for full refinement steps.

tools.name: af-disorder - Intrinsic Disorder & Flexibility Profiling from AlphaFold pLDDT
tools.usage: af-disorder is a specialized bioinformatics toolkit for calculating intrinsic disorder profiles, conformational flexibility, and conditional order-disorder transitions from AlphaFold structures and confidence metrics.
tools.strengths: Fast, lightweight disorder annotation without training new heavy neural networks.
tools.weaknesses: Low pLDDT can occasionally reflect lack of homologous sequence depth rather than disorder.

tools.name: Chai-1 (chaidiscovery/chai-1) - Open Weights for All-Atom Multi-Modal Biomolecular Prediction
tools.usage: Chai-1 model weights on HuggingFace provide open-access state-of-the-art all-atom structure prediction for multi-component complexes comprising proteins, nucleic acids (DNA/RNA), small molecule ligands, and post-translational modifications.
tools.strengths: Freely available weights for non-commercial and academic benchmarking.
tools.weaknesses: Substantial GPU VRAM required for large multi-chain complexes.

tools.name: Protenix All-Atom (oteam/protenix-all-atom) - Open All-Atom Biomolecular Structure Predictor
tools.usage: Protenix All-Atom checkpoints on HuggingFace deliver an open, high-accuracy all-atom biomolecular structure prediction model for complex biological assemblies.
tools.strengths: High fidelity on protein-protein interfaces and nucleic acid co-factors.
tools.weaknesses: Requires high GPU memory during full Pairformer attention passes.

tools.name: AlphaFlow-MD - Flow Matching Checkpoints for Protein Dynamic Ensembles
tools.usage: AlphaFlow-MD model checkpoints on HuggingFace provide pretrained flow matching models trained on extensive molecular dynamics (MD) trajectories, sampling realistic conformational ensembles of proteins in solution.
tools.strengths: Drastic speedup for generating thermodynamic conformational ensembles.
tools.weaknesses: Ensemble validity depends on the quality of underlying MD force field training distributions.

tools.name: ProtFlow-Docking - DeepChem Flow Matching Checkpoints for Ligand Docking
tools.usage: ProtFlow-Docking model checkpoints by DeepChem provide pretrained generative flow matching models for automated small-molecule pose placement and affinity scoring on protein pockets.
tools.strengths: Plug-and-play Python inference within the DeepChem ecosystem.
tools.weaknesses: Restricted to standard organic drug-like small molecules.

tools.name: RFdiffusion-AA (BakerLab/RFdiffusion-AA) - All-Atom Generative Binder Design Checkpoints
tools.usage: RFdiffusion All-Atom model checkpoints on HuggingFace enable direct all-atom de novo protein binder generation conditioned on small molecules, nucleic acids, and metal coordination motifs.
tools.strengths: Gold standard for experimental computational binder and enzyme design.
tools.weaknesses: Requires multi-step filtering and sequence redesign pipelines.

tools.name: Chai-1 Web Space - Interactive All-Atom Biomolecular Structure Prediction
tools.usage: Chai-1 Web Space is an interactive zero-install web application on HuggingFace Spaces providing instant browser-based prediction of protein complexes, antibodies, nucleic acids, and bound ligands with 3D Mol* visualization.
tools.strengths: Zero setup or local GPU hardware required for rapid interactive exploration.
tools.weaknesses: Queue times and execution timeouts for large molecular assemblies.

tools.name: Boltz-1 Demo Space - Interactive All-Atom Biomolecular Modeling
tools.usage: Boltz-1 Demo Space is an interactive web demonstration for running Boltz-1 all-atom structural predictions on custom protein sequences, ligands, and nucleic acids in real-time.
tools.strengths: Instant browser-based testbed for assessing Boltz-1 capabilities.
tools.weaknesses: Limited computational resources for large multimers.

tools.name: Protein Binder Design Space - Interactive De Novo Binder Scaffolding
tools.usage: Protein Binder Design Space is an interactive web interface on HuggingFace Spaces for designing target-specific de novo protein binders against uploaded PDB target structures.
tools.strengths: Accessible web interface for protein engineers to prototype binder designs.
tools.weaknesses: Best suited for short binders (< 150 residues).

tools.name: Antibody Epitope Mapper - Interactive Antigen Interface & Paratope Profiling Space
tools.usage: Antibody Epitope Mapper is an interactive HuggingFace Space for rapid structural mapping of antibody-antigen interfaces, CDR residue contact frequencies, and conformational epitope identification.
tools.strengths: Intuitive web interface for structural immunologists and antibody engineers.
tools.weaknesses: Requires pre-computed 3D coordinate inputs.

tools.name: Protein Sidechain Packer - Deep Learning Rotamer Optimization Space
tools.usage: Protein Sidechain Packer is an interactive HuggingFace Space providing zero-setup neural network sidechain rotamer placement and clash alleviation for backbone scaffolds.
tools.strengths: Sub-second sidechain packing across entire protein structures.
tools.weaknesses: Preserves backbone coordinates without induced-fit adjustments.

tools.name: Benchmark Evaluation of Protein Interface Binding Free Energies via AlphaFold-Multimer
tools.usage: This benchmark comprehensively assesses the correlation between AlphaFold-Multimer confidence metrics (ipTM, iPAE, interface contact surface area) and experimental binding free energies (delta G / Kd) across thousands of complexes.
tools.strengths: Crucial empirical guidance for filtering false positives in proteome-scale interaction screens.
tools.weaknesses: Correlation drops for complexes governed heavily by entropic or solvent-mediated effects.

tools.name: Awesome-Bio-Foundation-Models - Curated Bio-Foundation Models for Proteins, RNA, DNA, and Single-Cell
tools.usage: A comprehensive, community-curated repository tracking biological foundation models spanning proteins, DNA, RNA, molecules, and single-cell omics with benchmarks, pre-trained weights, and tutorials.
tools.strengths: High community engagement and constantly updated reference repository.
tools.weaknesses: Catalog/framework repository rather than a standalone generative model.

tools.name: EquiDock - Geometric Deep Learning for Fast Rigid 3D Protein-Protein Docking
tools.usage: EquiDock is a pioneer geometric deep learning model for rigid body 3D protein-protein docking that directly predicts the 3D rotation and translation of receptor and ligand structures via SE(3)-equivariant graph neural networks.
tools.strengths: Blazing fast inference speed suitable for proteome-wide interactome screening.
tools.weaknesses: Assumes rigid body backbone geometry; does not model induced-fit sidechain or loop adjustments.

tools.name: ProCyon - Multimodal Foundation Model for Protein Phenotypes and Functional Characterization
tools.usage: Developed by Harvard MIMS, ProCyon is a multimodal protein foundation model that unifies sequence, 3D AlphaFold structures, text descriptions, and biomedical ontologies to predict cellular phenotypes and molecular mechanisms.
tools.strengths: Bridges molecular structural representations with organism-level phenotype and disease phenotypes.
tools.weaknesses: High compute requirements for full cross-modal inference.

tools.name: AntiBERTy - Antibody-Specific Masked Language Model for Immune Engineering
tools.usage: AntiBERTy is a specialized transformer language model pre-trained on hundreds of millions of natural antibody sequences from Observed Antibody Space (OAS), tailored for antibody humanization, sequence restoration, and affinity maturation.
tools.strengths: Compact and fast antibody language model with broad adoption in therapeutic antibody discovery.
tools.weaknesses: Sequence-based architecture; benefits from pairing with structural folding tools (AlphaFold-Multimer, Chai-1).

tools.name: Sapiens - Human Antibody Language Model for Therapeutic Engineering
tools.usage: Developed by Merck, Sapiens is a human antibody language model based on BERT, trained exclusively on human heavy and light chain repertoires to guide antibody humanization, humanness scoring, and immunogenicity mitigation.
tools.strengths: Validated in industrial therapeutic pipelines at Merck; robust humanness metric.
tools.weaknesses: Specialized strictly for human antibody sequences; does not model camelid nanobodies or TCRs.

tools.name: ab_opt - Generative Diffusion Models for Antibody Design, Docking, and Optimization
tools.usage: ab_opt is an open-source framework implementing generative diffusion models for co-designing antibody CDR sequence and 3D structure conditioned on target antigen epitopes.
tools.strengths: Produces physically realistic, high-affinity CDR-H3 conformations.
tools.weaknesses: Requires high-resolution 3D coordinate inputs for target antigen.

tools.name: CryoSegNet - Foundation Image Segmentation Models for Cryo-EM Particle Picking
tools.usage: CryoSegNet is a deep learning foundation segmentation network developed by Jianlin Cheng lab for automated and accurate single-particle picking in low signal-to-noise Cryo-EM micrographs.
tools.strengths: High generalization across diverse macromolecular sizes and low-contrast cryo-EM micrographs.
tools.weaknesses: Requires GPU acceleration for high-throughput automated real-time acquisition pipelines.

tools.name: Cryo2Struct - Deep Learning for Converting Cryo-EM Density Maps to Protein Structures
tools.usage: Cryo2Struct utilizes 3D convolutional and transformer architectures to directly predict 3D atomic coordinates of protein backbones and amino acid sequences from experimental Cryo-EM electron density maps.
tools.strengths: Accelerates de novo Cryo-EM model building without manual threading.
tools.weaknesses: Dependent on Cryo-EM map resolution and local density quality.

tools.name: protein_tune_rl - Protein Design with Infilling Language Models and Reinforcement Learning
tools.usage: Developed by Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL), protein_tune_rl applies reinforcement learning policy optimization to guide protein language models for targeted sequence infilling, antibody engineering, and stability enhancement.
tools.strengths: Flexible framework bridging large language models with empirical screening objectives.
tools.weaknesses: Requires careful tuning of reward weights to avoid adversarial sequence exploitation.

tools.name: ProteinCAD - Open-Source Orchestration Platform for Multi-Model Protein Biomolecular CAD
tools.usage: ProteinCAD is an open-source biomolecular computer-aided design orchestration suite hosted on GitLab, unifying AlphaFold 2/3, RFdiffusion, ProteinMPNN, and MD simulations into unified computational workflows.
tools.strengths: Clean architectural abstraction over heterogeneous structural biology tools.
tools.weaknesses: Requires pre-configured container environments for GPU-accelerated tools.

tools.name: ieo-alphafold2 - High-Throughput Nextflow AlphaFold Pipeline for HPC
tools.usage: Developed by the European Institute of Oncology (IEO) Bioinformatics Unit, ieo-alphafold2 is a production-ready Nextflow pipeline for high-throughput batch AlphaFold 2 and AlphaFold-Multimer predictions on distributed HPC clusters.
tools.strengths: Robust error handling, resume capabilities, and enterprise-grade Nextflow implementation.
tools.weaknesses: Requires local access to heavy AlphaFold reference genetic databases (~2.5TB).

tools.name: graph-transformer-pytorch - Graph Transformer Implementation for Biomolecular Structure Modeling
tools.usage: An elegant, modular PyTorch implementation of Graph Transformers featuring edge-conditioned multi-head attention and relational positional encodings, widely used as a building block in biomolecular folding networks.
tools.strengths: Clean, lightweight PyTorch code for researchers building custom folding and docking networks.
tools.weaknesses: Low-level deep learning module rather than an end-to-end trained folding pipeline.

tools.name: alphafold-slurm - Automated Slurm Multi-GPU Cluster Orchestration for AlphaFold
tools.usage: A robust suite of Slurm array and multi-node submission scripts configured for maximizing GPU utilization during large-scale proteome-wide AlphaFold structure prediction runs.
tools.strengths: Turn-key deployment for university and institutional supercomputing clusters.
tools.weaknesses: Tailored specifically to Slurm workload managers.

tools.name: structural-biology-analysis - Python Toolkit for Protein Conformation & Binding Analysis
tools.usage: A comprehensive open-source Python toolkit on GitLab for batch structural analysis of AlphaFold and experimental protein models, calculating residue contact maps, binding cavity geometry, and conformational clustering.
tools.strengths: Clean, lightweight library with minimal dependencies for high-throughput structural bioinformatics.
tools.weaknesses: Focuses on post-prediction analysis; does not perform structure generation.

tools.name: nanopro - Solid-State Nanopore Analysis Tool for DNA-Protein Assemblies
tools.usage: Developed by Keyser Lab, nanopro processes solid-state nanopore event data to analyze the structural translocation dynamics and binding stoichiometry of DNA-protein assemblies and CRISPR-Cas9 complexes.
tools.strengths: Powerful experimental validation suite for large nucleoprotein assemblies.
tools.weaknesses: Designed for solid-state nanopore electrical data formats.

tools.name: Boltz-2 Community Weights (boltz-community/boltz-2) - Distilled All-Atom Predictor
tools.usage: Open model weights and checkpoint files for Boltz-2 hosted by the community on HuggingFace, providing ultra-fast distilled diffusion inference for all-atom biomolecular modeling including ligands, RNA, and proteins.
tools.strengths: Standard open distribution point for Boltz-2 model weights with 16+ community likes.
tools.weaknesses: Requires compatible Boltz-2 PyTorch runtime.

tools.name: alphafold3-view (Jhsmit/alphafold3-view) - Interactive AlphaFold 3 Complex Visualizer
tools.usage: An interactive HuggingFace Space developed by Jhsmit for visualizing AlphaFold 3 and Boltz-1 complex predictions, featuring integrated 3D structure rendering with Mol*, PAE matrix heatmaps, and per-atom confidence profiling.
tools.strengths: Zero-installation web tool for rapid structural inspection of AlphaFold 3 outputs.
tools.weaknesses: Client-side web viewer; limited to files under browser memory limits.

tools.name: AlphaFold2.jl (MurrellLab/AlphaFold2.jl) - Julia AlphaFold Model Weights & Interface
tools.usage: Hosted by Murrell Lab on HuggingFace, this repository provides optimized weight distributions and model configurations for AlphaFold2.jl, the pure Julia implementation of AlphaFold for high-performance computing.
tools.strengths: Native Julia ecosystem support with excellent compute efficiency.
tools.weaknesses: Designed primarily for Julia environments.

tools.name: OneScience AlphaFold3 (OneScience-Group/AlphaFold3) - Open Weights Reproduction
tools.usage: Open model weights and architectural configs developed by OneScience Group for all-atom biomolecular structure prediction reproducing AlphaFold 3 specifications.
tools.strengths: Community-accessible all-atom model checkpoint for academic validation.
tools.weaknesses: Requires corresponding inference code repository.

tools.name: Knots DistillProtBERT (EvaKlimentova/knots_distillprotbert_alphafold) - Protein Knot Detection
tools.usage: A fine-tuned DistillProtBERT transformer model developed by Eva Klimentova for detecting topological knots, slipknots, and complex entanglements in AlphaFold predicted protein structures.
tools.strengths: Fills a crucial gap in structural quality assessment and topological classification.
tools.weaknesses: Classification model; requires downstream mathematical knot verification (e.g. KNotify) for exact knot coordinates.

tools.name: BoltzDesign1 (JoeyCh/BoltzDesign1) - Inverted All-Atom Diffusion Binder Design Checkpoints
tools.usage: Checkpoints for BoltzDesign1 on HuggingFace, an inverted all-atom structure prediction framework for generalized de novo biomolecular binder design targeting proteins, nucleic acids, and small molecules.
tools.strengths: Universal binder design architecture across all biomolecular modalities.
tools.weaknesses: Computationally intensive generation compared to sequence-only inverse folding.

tools.name: Synthyra Boltz-2 (Synthyra/Boltz2) - Accelerated Distilled All-Atom Inference Model
tools.usage: Optimized Boltz-2 model weights distributed by Synthyra on HuggingFace with 69+ downloads, configured for high-throughput batch inference and virtual screening integration.
tools.strengths: Active download activity and verified weights for industrial and academic clusters.
tools.weaknesses: Standard hardware dependencies (NVIDIA CUDA).

tools.name: BoltzGen Post-Training (escalante-bio/boltzgen-posttraining) - Fine-Tuned Biomolecular Generative Weights
tools.usage: Post-trained generative checkpoints for BoltzGen by escalante-bio, fine-tuned for high-fidelity de novo protein and binder generation with enhanced structural compactness and designability.
tools.strengths: Improved designability and physical realism for de novo generated scaffolds.
tools.weaknesses: Specialized for protein backbone generation and binder scaffolds.

tools.name: Structural Plausibility Without Binding Specificity: Limits of AI-Based Antibody-Antigen Structure Predictors
tools.usage: A critical benchmarking study on bioRxiv demonstrating that modern all-atom AI models (AlphaFold-Multimer, Chai-1, Boltz-1) often predict structurally plausible antibody-antigen complexes even for non-binding antibody variants, highlighting the need for calibrated physical scoring.
tools.strengths: Crucial cautionary guidance and remediation strategies for computational antibody engineering.
tools.weaknesses: Focuses on diagnostic assessment rather than introducing a new prediction architecture.

tools.name: Evaluation of De Novo Deep Learning Models on the Protein-Sugar Interactome
tools.usage: A comprehensive benchmark assessing AlphaFold 3, Chai-1, and Boltz-1 across hundreds of protein-carbohydrate and glycoprotein complexes, evaluating glycosylation site accuracy, glycan ring conformations, and binding pocket interactions.
tools.strengths: First comprehensive benchmark targeting the notoriously challenging protein-glycan interactome.
tools.weaknesses: Highlights persistent challenges in modeling highly flexible branched poly-glycans.

tools.name: AlphaFold 1
tools.usage: First-generation neural network predicting inter-residue distances and orientations for ab initio folding.
tools.strengths: Won CASP13; proved deep learning is highly viable for structural biology prediction.
tools.weaknesses: Did not predict atomic coordinates directly; required physical gradient descent to build 3D models.
tools.github_description: AlphaFold 1: original neural network for distance prediction.

tools.name: AlphaFold 2
tools.usage: Atomic-level structure prediction of proteins from sequence and MSAs.
tools.strengths: Outstanding accuracy, massive public database (AFDB), industry gold standard.
tools.weaknesses: High computational requirements, slow MSA search, struggles with non-protein ligands and disordered structures.
tools.github_description: Open source code for AlphaFold 2.

tools.weaknesses: Limited to design around pre-positioned static molecules; cannot generate ligand conformations natively.

tools.name: Chroma
tools.usage: Generative program for custom protein structures and sequences under customizable design conditions.
tools.strengths: End-to-end (backbone + sequence) generation, supports advanced geometric constraints.
tools.weaknesses: Model weights require a commercial API key from Generate:Biomedicines.
tools.github_description: A generative model for programmable protein design

tools.name: ColabDesign
tools.usage: Interactive framework for protein backbone/sequence design via Google Colab powered by AF2 and ProteinMPNN.
tools.strengths: Accessible design protocols (binder design, hallucination, fixedbb) with rich visual notebooks.
tools.weaknesses: Primarily notebook-oriented; requires adaptation for non-interactive high-throughput command-line execution.
tools.github_description: Interactive framework for protein backbone/sequence design via Google Colab powered by AF2 and ProteinMPNN.

tools.name: SwitchCraft
tools.usage: Programmatic protein design framework optimizing state-switching and allosteric conformational changes via backpropagation on structure predictors.
tools.strengths: Enables multi-state conformational design (activating/deactivating states), optimizes fluorescent biosensors, uses differentiable constraint graphs.
tools.weaknesses: Requires complex custom parameterization of target state constraints and substantial GPU memory for backpropagation.
tools.github_description: SwitchCraft: A Programmatic Framework for Designing State-Switching Proteins

citing_papers.title: SwitchCraft: A Programmatic Framework for Designing State-Switching Proteins

tools.name: BindCraft
tools.usage: Automated de novo miniprotein binder design combining AlphaFold2, ColabDesign, ProteinMPNN, and PyRosetta/OpenMM.
tools.strengths: High experimental success rate, designs binders for challenging targets in-silico, open-source.
tools.weaknesses: Requires high GPU resources for hallucination/backpropagation, PyRosetta requires commercial license.
tools.github_description: BindCraft: One-shot design of functional protein binders using AlphaFold2, ColabDesign, ProteinMPNN and PyRosetta.

tools.name: Ovo
tools.usage: Published in Communications Biology (2026), Ovo is an open-source Python ecosystem designed to seamlessly unify structural generative diffusion models, inverse-folding networks, biophysical scoring, and automated filtering into reproducible protein design protocols.
tools.strengths: Greatly reduces software fragmentation and boilerplate code in protein engineering labs.
tools.weaknesses: Requires local installations of underlying deep learning packages.
tools.github_description: An Open-Source Modular Ecosystem for De Novo Protein Design

citing_papers.title: Ovo, an Open-Source Ecosystem for De Novo Protein Design

tools.name: PiFold
tools.usage: Rapid structure-conditioned sequence generation model using 3D node and edge feature projections.
tools.strengths: Faster than ProteinMPNN on single chain structures, excellent recovery of natural sequence motifs.
tools.weaknesses: Limited support for multi-chain assemblies containing non-protein cofactors.
tools.github_description: PiFold: Physics-informed inverse folding.

tools.name: ESM-IF1
tools.usage: Inverse folding model using GNNs to predict sequences matching custom target backbones.
tools.strengths: Pre-trained on millions of structures, integrates sequence likelihood scores to screen stable designs.
tools.weaknesses: Slightly less flexible for loop optimization than ProteinMPNN.
tools.github_description: ESM Inverse Folding model.

tools.name: ProtGPT2
tools.usage: Generative transformer model to output novel de novo sequence profiles based on natural protein space.
tools.strengths: Requires zero input structures; designs highly soluble and folded chains directly from raw generation.
tools.weaknesses: Generates sequences without spatial constraint capabilities.
tools.github_description: ProtGPT2: Deep generative sequence model.

tools.name: ProGen
tools.usage: AI sequence designer generating functional proteins across families controlled by natural specification tags.
tools.strengths: Demonstrated successful wet-lab synthesis of functional lysozymes designed from scratch.
tools.weaknesses: Requires tags for conditioning; does not support 3D geometric constraints natively.
tools.github_description: ProGen sequence design model.

tools.name: ProGen2
tools.usage: Antibody - Fine-Tuned 6.4B Large Language Model for Generative Antibody Design
tools.strengths: Directly accessible via HuggingFace `AutoModelForCausalLM`; high sequence diversity and humanness.
tools.weaknesses: Requires GPU with >=16GB VRAM for full 6.4B checkpoint generation.
tools.github_description: Antibody - Fine-Tuned 6.4B Large Language Model for Generative Antibody Design

tools.name: EvoDiff
tools.usage: Sequence-based diffusion model generating functional proteins directly without structural inputs.
tools.strengths: Captures structural constraints implicitly; highly viable sequences for disordered structures.
tools.weaknesses: Inference is slower than direct language model autoregressive sampling.
tools.github_description: EvoDiff sequence diffusion.

tools.name: RFdesign
tools.usage: Inpainting and hallucination tool based on RoseTTAFold for building custom binding interfaces.
tools.strengths: Excellent motif scaffolding capabilities.
tools.weaknesses: Preceded by RFdiffusion; slower and less robust poses than current diffusion suites.
tools.github_description: RFdesign: RoseTTAFold-based protein design.

tools.name: ProteinGenerator
tools.usage: End-to-end design generator optimizing backbones and sequences simultaneously via RoseTTAFold checkpoints.
tools.strengths: Direct linkage of sequence and structure during optimization, avoids mismatched folds.
tools.weaknesses: High GPU compute required; optimization can stall in local minima.
tools.github_description: ProteinGenerator simultaneous design model.

tools.name: EvoProtGrad
tools.usage: Directed evolution simulator using gradient-based guidance on protein language models and inverse folding outputs.
tools.strengths: Drastically search-efficient; outputs mutated variants with increased expression or affinity.
tools.weaknesses: Heavy dependence on quality of grading score models (e.g. ESM-1v).
tools.github_description: EvoProtGrad directed design solver.

tools.name: AlphaMissense
tools.usage: Pathogenicity classification of human missense single-nucleotide variants.
tools.strengths: Classified 89% of all human missense variants with 90% confidence, outperforming standard conservation methods.
tools.weaknesses: Outputs database tables; code is reference-only and not structured for new protein predictions.
tools.github_description: Pathogenicity classification of human missense single-nucleotide variants.

tools.name: ESM-1v
tools.usage: Zero-shot prediction of variant effects and mutational fitness landscapes using language model masks.
tools.strengths: Excellent benchmark accuracy for variant engineering, fast scoring.
tools.weaknesses: Does not predict structural consequences directly; sequence-only model.
tools.github_description: ESM-1v variant prediction checkpoints.

tools.name: ESM-2
tools.usage: State-of-the-art transformer representation of evolutionary sequence records.
tools.strengths: Powering ESMFold, outstanding downstream transfer learning features.
tools.weaknesses: Requires massive training datasets, highly parameter-dense.
tools.github_description: ESM-2 evolutionary representation model.

tools.name: VIPER
tools.usage: Visual inspector tool identifying variant clusters and mapping fitness predictions onto 3D structures.
tools.strengths: Highlights functional hotspots in protein assemblies dynamically.
tools.weaknesses: Lacks direct prediction modules; relies entirely on ESM/AlphaFold databases.
tools.github_description: VIPER mutational visualization.

tools.name: SoluProt
tools.usage: Machine learning prediction of protein solubility in E. coli expression systems.
tools.strengths: Highly reliable classification for screening synthetic design candidates.
tools.weaknesses: Lacks structure-level interaction physics.
tools.github_description: SoluProt solubility predictor.

tools.name: MutCompute
tools.usage: CNN classifier trained on protein microenvironments to engineer stabilizing mutations.
tools.strengths: Successfully engineered highly stable PET-depolymerizing enzymes (FAST-PETase).
tools.weaknesses: Limited resolution on highly flexible loop structures.
tools.github_description: MutCompute protein engineering CNN.

tools.name: ESM-Finetune
tools.usage: Finetuning pipelines for adapting ESM-2 checkpoints to specific enzymatic activity data.
tools.strengths: Allows highly customized fitness predictions with very small datasets.
tools.weaknesses: Prone to overfitting if sequence variation is too narrow.
tools.github_description: ESM-Finetune pipeline.

tools.name: DeepSequence
tools.usage: Deep generative latent models (VAEs) predicting mutation effects based on alignment logs.
tools.strengths: Highly accurate zero-shot fitness modeling across diverse protein families.
tools.weaknesses: Requires deep MSAs; inference is relatively slow compared to language models.
tools.github_description: DeepSequence VAE model.

tools.name: Foldseek
tools.usage: Fast, sensitive structural search and alignment against millions of predicted structures in AFDB.
tools.strengths: 10,000x faster than Dali/TM-align, integrates structural alphabet (3D-states) into sequence-based search.
tools.weaknesses: May miss fine-grained structural alignments compared to full rigid coordinate superposition.
tools.github_description: Foldseek enables fast and sensitive comparisons of large structure sets.

tools.name: Foldseek Multimer
tools.usage: Searching structural databases using multi-chain assembly configurations.
tools.strengths: Identifies matching quaternary interfaces in milliseconds.
tools.weaknesses: Relies heavily on model coordinate integrity of multimeric inputs.
tools.github_description: Foldseek Multimer alignments.

tools.name: AlphaFind
tools.usage: Fast shape-based structural comparison and search against predictions in the AlphaFold Database.
tools.strengths: Enables discovery of remote structural homologs, intuitive web interface and programmatic API.
tools.weaknesses: Searches only within the pre-computed AlphaFold Database; cannot align arbitrary user-provided structures.
tools.github_description: AlphaFind: shape-based search in structural databases

citing_papers.title: AlphaFind: a web server for structural similarity search of the AlphaFold database

tools.name: AlphaFind v2
tools.usage: Next-generation structural search optimized with advanced embedding models for extreme-speed shape searches.
tools.strengths: Even faster indexing, supports multimeric searches, integrates structural alignments with sequence conservation.
tools.weaknesses: Very newly released preprint status, still in active deployment phase.
tools.github_description: AlphaFind v2: fast shape-based search in structural databases

citing_papers.title: AlphaFind v2: fast shape-based search in structural databases

tools.name: Foldcomp
tools.usage: Highly optimized compression framework for storing and streaming millions of PDB/AlphaFold coordinate files.
tools.strengths: Up to 10x smaller file sizes, allows instantaneous loading of complete proteomes.
tools.weaknesses: Lossy compression (retains backbone and C-beta coordinates only).
tools.github_description: Foldcomp structure compression.

tools.name: USalign
tools.usage: Universal structural alignment program aligning proteins, DNA, RNA, or mixed molecular complexes.
tools.strengths: Outstanding accuracy, handles completely mismatched sequence profiles using TM-score normalization.
tools.weaknesses: Slow on massive databases containing millions of structures compared to Foldseek.
tools.github_description: USalign structural alignment solver.

tools.name: TM-align
tools.usage: Classical structural alignment program computing TM-scores between target chains.
tools.strengths: De facto standard metric for evaluating predicted structural quality.
tools.weaknesses: CPU-bound, not designed for web-scale database searches.
tools.github_description: TM-align structure comparison.

tools.name: Dali
tools.usage: Distance alignment matrix solver mapping structural contacts in 3D space.
tools.strengths: Identifies highly remote structural homology missed by coordinate superposition.
tools.weaknesses: Highly resource-intensive quadratic alignment search.
tools.github_description: Dali structural similarity engine.

tools.name: DiffDock
tools.usage: Diffusion-based blind flexible molecular docking of small molecules to protein target structures.
tools.strengths: High pose prediction accuracy, avoids local minima in binding pockets, handles novel target structures.
tools.weaknesses: Assumes rigid protein structure, can output steric clashes requiring force field minimization.
tools.github_description: Implementation of DiffDock: Diffusion Steps, Twists, and Turns for Molecular Docking

github_top_forks.description: DiffDock implementation that adds support for HPC execution using Slurm and Singularity

github_top_forks.description: Implementation of DiffDock: Diffusion Steps, Twists, and Turns for Molecular Docking

github_top_forks.description: Fork of DiffDock designed for fine tuning.

github_top_forks.description: Implementation of DiffDock: Diffusion Steps, Twists, and Turns for Molecular Docking

github_top_forks.name: SuperXiang/DiffDock
github_top_forks.description: Implementation of DiffDock: Diffusion Steps, Twists, and Turns for Molecular Docking

tools.name: DiffDock-PP
tools.usage: Rigid protein-protein docking using deep translation/rotation diffusion models.
tools.strengths: Handles huge assemblies quickly, avoids grid search calculations.
tools.weaknesses: Does not model interface side-chain conformational adjustments.
tools.github_description: DiffDock-PP protein docking.

tools.name: DiffDock-L
tools.usage: Docking optimized for peptide and macrocyclic complex binding poses.
tools.strengths: Excellent flexibility handling for large rings.
tools.weaknesses: Requires longer diffusion steps for multi-torsion interfaces.
tools.github_description: DiffDock-L macrocycle poses.

tools.name: FlowDock
tools.usage: Flow matching protein-ligand docking model predicting co-complex layouts directly.
tools.strengths: Outperforms diffusion speeds, natively includes backbone adaptability.
tools.weaknesses: Demands high GPU memory profiles during multi-chain refinement.
tools.github_description: FlowDock flow matching poses.

tools.name: DynamicBind
tools.usage: Flexible deep learning-based docking solver modeling induced-fit pocket changes.
tools.strengths: Handles side-chain coordinate shift predictions during ligand alignment.
tools.weaknesses: Can yield unrealistic conformational states on small pockets.
tools.github_description: DynamicBind flexible pocket solver.

tools.name: EquiBind
tools.usage: Equivariant geometric neural network predicting ligand coordinates in one shot.
tools.strengths: Thousands of times faster than physics solvers, predicts pocket locations implicitly.
tools.weaknesses: Lacks refinement, prone to overlapping atoms without force field post-processing.
tools.github_description: EquiBind one-shot docking.

tools.name: TankBind
tools.usage: Trigonometry-aware neural network prediction for binding poses and affinity grids.
tools.strengths: Accurate coordination of target pockets, stable scoring metrics.
tools.weaknesses: Restricted performance when encountering novel metal cluster interfaces.
tools.github_description: TankBind structure-pose model.

tools.name: FABind
tools.usage: Fast, physics-aware ligand alignment architecture optimizing coordinate loss directly.
tools.strengths: Fast pose identification, robust on large multimeric cavities.
tools.weaknesses: Prone to errors on highly flexible open loops.
tools.github_description: FABind pocket alignment.

tools.name: Uni-Dock
tools.usage: GPU-accelerated molecular docking engine based on AutoDock Vina protocols.
tools.strengths: Massive throughput acceleration (10-50x), scales virtual screening to millions of compounds.
tools.weaknesses: Uses traditional scoring functions rather than deep learning representations.
tools.github_description: Uni-Dock GPU Vina model.

tools.name: AF2Complex
tools.usage: Predicting multi-chain assemblies and screening protein-protein interaction networks using modified AF2 weights.
tools.strengths: Calculates interface metrics (pDockQ) to identify true interaction partners.
tools.weaknesses: Demands huge GPU clusters for comprehensive screening arrays.
tools.github_description: AF2Complex multimer predictor.

tools.name: FoldDock
tools.usage: Docking of protein dimers using custom-built sequence alignment bridges directly inside AF2.
tools.strengths: Simple and fast multimer modeling before AF2-Multimer release.
tools.weaknesses: Struggles with large multimer assemblies (higher than trimers).
tools.github_description: FoldDock dimer docking.

tools.name: AlphaPulldown
tools.usage: Automated pipeline for high-throughput screening of protein-protein interactions (all-against-all or one-against-all).
tools.strengths: Automates MSAs, calculates interface scores, exports results in formats ready for Cytoscape.
tools.weaknesses: Inference computation cost is high for large screening grids.
tools.github_description: AlphaPulldown interaction screening.

tools.name: IgFold
tools.usage: Antibody structure prediction using pre-trained language models and specialized structural targets.
tools.strengths: Outstanding accuracy on flexible antibody loops (H3 loops), predicts structures in seconds.
tools.weaknesses: Restricted to immunoglobulin variable domains; cannot fold general proteins.
tools.github_description: IgFold antibody predictor.

tools.name: LYRA
tools.usage: Antibody and T-cell receptor (TCR) structural modeling tool incorporating specialized templates.
tools.strengths: Fast modeling, incorporates canonical loop conformations.
tools.weaknesses: Lacks direct end-to-end deep learning backpropagation.
tools.github_description: LYRA TCR/Antibody modeler.

tools.name: AbFold
tools.usage: Specialized antibody folding model utilizing template-matching constraints in conjunction with ESM weights.
tools.strengths: Highly accurate CDR loop structures, handles nanobodies.
tools.weaknesses: Slower than IgFold due to physics-based template checks.
tools.github_description: AbFold antibody folding system.

tools.name: NanobodyFold
tools.usage: Refining and folding nanobody architectures with specific variable region parameters.
tools.strengths: Optimized for single-chain VHH designs.
tools.weaknesses: Limited capabilities when modeling complex multimeric antibody formats.
tools.github_description: NanobodyFold VHH modeler.

tools.name: RFantibody
tools.usage: Antibody design using adapted RoseTTAFold weights to design variable loop scaffolds.
tools.strengths: Integrates with RFdiffusion for de novo antibody binder generation.
tools.weaknesses: CDR loop design success rates are lower than standard RFdiffusion binder pipelines.
tools.github_description: RFantibody designer.

tools.name: DiffAb
tools.usage: Generative model optimizing antibody sequence and structure jointly using 3D diffusion coordinates.
tools.strengths: Excellent pose viability on target CDR loops.
tools.weaknesses: Requires force-field post-processing to correct stereochemical bond angles.
tools.github_description: DiffAb antibody diffusion solver.

tools.name: Phenix-AlphaFold
tools.usage: Integrating AlphaFold models into crystallographic molecular replacement and refinement pipelines inside Phenix.
tools.strengths: Automates template trimming, solves challenging molecular replacement cases where traditional structures fail.
tools.weaknesses: Proprietary license components inside Phenix; requires local installations.
tools.github_description: Phenix structural biology integration.

tools.name: CryoREAD
tools.usage: Automated de novo building of proteins and nucleic acids directly from Cryo-EM density maps.
tools.strengths: Extremely fast structure building, performs well at medium to low resolutions.
tools.weaknesses: Relies on density map quality; may misassign sequence identities in local regions.
tools.github_description: CryoREAD de novo EM modeler.

tools.name: DeepFold-EM
tools.usage: Refining protein coordinates in low-resolution Cryo-EM maps combining deep networks with physics refinement.
tools.strengths: Stabilizes secondary structure conformations, fits large assemblies accurately.
tools.weaknesses: High GPU compute required for iterative conformation searches.
tools.github_description: DeepFold-EM structures.

tools.name: CryoFold
tools.usage: Fitting AlphaFold predictions to dynamic Cryo-EM map densities using differentiable simulation blocks.
tools.strengths: Captures alternative active/inactive states directly from raw density profiles.
tools.weaknesses: Inference time is high, requires careful input constraint setups.
tools.github_description: CryoFold density-fitter.

tools.name: ISOLDE
tools.usage: Interactive molecular dynamics flexible fitting of AF2 coordinates into crystallographic or Cryo-EM maps.
tools.strengths: Allows real-time manual editing of structures while physics fields prevent bond overlap.
tools.weaknesses: Requires visual monitoring; not designed for automated high-throughput execution.
tools.github_description: ISOLDE interactive fitting.

tools.name: Phaser-AlphaFold
tools.usage: Using AlphaFold models directly for molecular replacement calculations inside Phaser solver.
tools.strengths: Integrates error estimates (pLDDT) into the likelihood targets for search templates.
tools.weaknesses: Templates require truncation of low-confidence loops beforehand.
tools.github_description: Phaser molecular replacement.

tools.name: MrBump
tools.usage: Automated pipeline for molecular replacement using search models retrieved from AlphaFold DB.
tools.strengths: Saves hours of search preparation, pipelines multiple domains automatically.
tools.weaknesses: Dependent on the presence of related structural domains in databases.
tools.github_description: MrBump automated pipeline.

tools.name: AMPLE
tools.usage: Molecular replacement using clusters of truncated ab initio/AlphaFold structures.
tools.strengths: Solves structures with no known template structure homologs.
tools.weaknesses: Computationally intensive; requires trying many cluster variations.
tools.github_description: AMPLE molecular replacement.

tools.name: SIMBAD
tools.usage: Sequence-independent molecular replacement scanning crystallographic database models.
tools.strengths: Solves structures when the sequence annotation is incorrect or missing.
tools.weaknesses: Requires searching thousands of models, high computation cost.
tools.github_description: SIMBAD independent MR.

tools.name: Modelcraft
tools.usage: Automated protein model building combining network coordinates with density fitting protocols.
tools.strengths: End-to-end building, drastically limits manual adjustment requirements.
tools.weaknesses: Lacks precision on heavily disordered chain regions.
tools.github_description: Modelcraft automated building.

tools.name: AlphaFold DB
tools.usage: Accessing over 200 million 3D protein structure predictions freely available online.
tools.strengths: Massive repository covering human proteome and 48 key model organisms, easy programmatic access.
tools.weaknesses: Contains unrefined predictions, lacks small molecule ligands, nucleic acids, and cofactor annotations.
tools.github_description: Open source code for AlphaFold 2.

github_top_forks.description: Open source code for AlphaFold.

citing_papers.authors: Mihály Váradi, Stephen Anyango et al.

tools.name: AlphaFill
tools.usage: Enriching AlphaFold DB models with transplanted ligands, cofactors, and metal ions, and providing a public web databank (https://alphafill.eu/) of pre-computed structures.
tools.strengths: Restores biological and chemical context for millions of apo-predictions; freely accessible web databank and standalone algorithm with local alignment scores.
tools.weaknesses: Transplant-based modeling can introduce steric clashes or incorrect positions in dynamic pockets.
tools.github_description: Enriching AlphaFold DB models by transplanting missing ligands, cofactors, and metal ions.

citing_papers.title: AlphaFill: enriching AlphaFold models with ligands and cofactors

tools.name: αCharges
tools.usage: Calculation and visualization of partial atomic charges for AlphaFold DB models.
tools.strengths: Provides crucial electrostatic charge annotations for structural models, uses rapid empirical methods.
tools.weaknesses: Accuracy depends heavily on the quality of the underlying AlphaFold DB coordinate model.
tools.github_description: αCharges: partial atomic charge calculations on AlphaFold models.

citing_papers.title: αCharges: a database of partial atomic charges for AlphaFold Library models

tools.name: ESM Atlas
tools.usage: Database containing over 600 million predicted structures from metagenomic sequence samples.
tools.strengths: Massive structural expansion, covers dark matter of sequence databases.
tools.weaknesses: Predictions are single-chain only; lacks multimeric context.
tools.github_description: ESM Metagenomic Atlas.

tools.name: Foldcomp DB
tools.usage: Accessing compressed structural libraries of the complete AlphaFold Database to stream locally.
tools.strengths: Allows running Foldseek searches locally without massive data storage footprints.
tools.weaknesses: Lacks side-chain coordinate information.
tools.github_description: Foldcomp compressed database.

tools.name: Fpocket-AFDB
tools.usage: Binding pocket annotations mapped across predicted structures in the AlphaFold Database.
tools.strengths: Identifies cryptic or druggable pockets across structural variants.
tools.weaknesses: Relies on rigid predictions which may close transient pockets.
tools.github_description: Fpocket database annotations.

tools.name: PocketMiner
tools.usage: Rapid machine learning classifier to identify cryptic druggable pockets in AlphaFold models.
tools.strengths: Extremely fast, identifies pockets requiring small conformational shifts.
tools.weaknesses: Accuracy dependent on local structure quality scores (pLDDT).
tools.github_description: PocketMiner pocket prediction.

tools.name: PocketOmics
tools.usage: Mapping human genomic variants onto binding pockets of AlphaFold models to infer functional disruption.
tools.strengths: Connects missense variants directly with structural drug pockets.
tools.weaknesses: Reliant on accuracy of pocket borders.
tools.github_description: PocketOmics genomic map.

tools.name: ESMFold DB
tools.usage: Precomputed structures of standard protein databases generated via ESMFold.
tools.strengths: Fast retrieval of standard families.
tools.weaknesses: Lacks custom multimeric assemblies.
tools.github_description: ESMFold structural databases.

tools.name: ChimeraX-AlphaFold
tools.usage: Interactive interface inside UCSF ChimeraX to fetch, display, and color structures by pLDDT confidence scores.
tools.strengths: Allows instant visual analysis, displays alignment metrics, processes predicted alignment error (PAE) matrices.
tools.weaknesses: Requires ChimeraX desktop application installation.
tools.github_description: ChimeraX AlphaFold extension.

Providing an open, modular foundation for all-atom biomolecular structure prediction, the repository implements the Pairformer stack, diffusion generative conditioning, multi-chain relative positional encodings, and all-atom loss formulations across proteins, DNA, RNA, ligands, ions, and modified residues.
tools.strengths: Vital open-source resource for academic research, mechanistic interpretability experiments, and custom model pretraining. Rapid community iteration and clean, readable code structure following lucidrains' standard PyTorch design paradigms.
tools.weaknesses: Provides model architecture and training scripts; pre-trained production model weights must be sourced or trained independently. Full training from scratch requires massive multi-GPU/TPU compute resources.

tools.name: Protenix-Dock
tools.usage: Protenix-Dock is ByteDance's accurate, end-to-end trainable deep learning framework for protein-ligand docking and complex structure prediction. It circumvents traditional grid search scoring functions by directly learning docking poses from biomolecular representations.
tools.strengths: Eliminates rigid receptor assumptions and classical scoring function grid errors.
tools.weaknesses: Requires pre-computed protein structure or co-prediction.
tools.github_description: An accurate and trainable end-to-end protein-ligand docking framework by ByteDance.

tools.name: Boltzdesign1
tools.usage: Boltzdesign1 is a protein and biomolecular binder design framework that inverts the open-source Boltz-1 structure prediction network. Rather than relying on separate diffusion models for backbone generation and inverse folding for sequence design, Boltzdesign1 optimizes candidate sequences and coordinates directly through gradient backpropagation through Boltz-1's Pairformer and diffusion modules, targeting high interface confidence and contact density against any biological target.
tools.strengths: Eliminates the discrepancy between design models and validation models by using the all-atom predictor directly as the design objective. Natively handles multi-component assemblies and co-factor-containing target sites.
tools.weaknesses: Gradient backpropagation through deep Pairformer blocks requires substantial GPU memory; requires activation checkpointing. Risk of adversarial sequence solutions that fool the neural network's confidence metrics without folding into stable physical proteins.
tools.github_description: De novo generative protein design model based on Boltz-1.

tools.name: AFM-Benchmark
tools.usage: AFM-Benchmark is an automated, reproducible benchmarking framework hosted on GitLab by the Elofsson Laboratory. It evaluates AlphaFold-Multimer performance across diverse protein-protein, antibody-antigen, and peptide-receptor interface benchmark sets.
tools.strengths: Provides objective, continuous benchmarking of multimer interface accuracy.
tools.weaknesses: Focused specifically on multimer interfaces rather than small molecule ligands.

tools.name: OpenFold 3
tools.usage: Open-source biomolecular structure prediction model reproducing AlphaFold 3 across proteins, nucleic acids, and ligands.
tools.strengths: Fully open weights, training pipelines, and permissive open-source license by OpenFold Consortium.
tools.weaknesses: Requires high GPU memory for full all-atom diffusion sampling.
tools.github_description: OpenFold 3: Fully open biomolecular structure prediction reproducing AlphaFold 3.

tools.name: BoltzGen
tools.usage: All-atom generative design framework unifying structure prediction with de novo binder and peptide generation across all molecular modalities.
tools.strengths: Integrates Boltz-1 representation directly into generative sampling funnels.
tools.weaknesses: Requires GPU compute for diffusion trajectories.
tools.github_description: BoltzGen: All-atom generative protein and peptide design.

tools.name: AlphaFraud
tools.usage: AlphaFraud is an open weekly automated audit tool and dataset hosted on Zenodo / OpenAlex that systematically checks newly deposited human protein structures for AlphaFold model accuracy, stereochemical anomalies, and pLDDT discrepancies.
tools.strengths: Essential quality assurance tool for structural biology datasets.
tools.weaknesses: Automated metrics require manual verification for complex domain packing.

tools.name: Chai-1 Epitope-Guided Pocket Restraints & AntiConf Evaluation
tools.usage: Recent peer-reviewed studies in EuropePMC and OpenAlex demonstrating that integrating B-cell epitope predictions as pocket restraints significantly boosts Chai-1 antibody-antigen complex precision, alongside the AntiConf benchmark evaluator.
tools.strengths: Directly applicable to therapeutic antibody structure prediction.
tools.weaknesses: Requires experimental or predicted epitope constraint inputs.

tools.name: GitLab Workflows: HT-Colabfold & ESM-1b binder_design
tools.usage: A suite of open GitLab repositories enabling high-throughput automated structural biology workflows: HT-Colabfold for screening large protein libraries and binder_design for evolutionary-guided sequence search targeting macromolecular surfaces.
tools.strengths: Streamlines high-throughput screening and binder design on local compute clusters.
tools.weaknesses: Requires SLURM or HPC orchestration configuration.

tools.name: Nesso-1 & Boltz-2 Affinity Fine-Tuning
tools.usage: Nesso-1 and Affinity Fine-Tuned Boltz-2 provide open-source frameworks for quantitative binding affinity ($K_i / IC_{50}$) prediction. They adapt 3D co-folding representations to predict structural potency for rational drug design.
tools.strengths: Bridge structural co-folding prediction with functional affinity metrics.
tools.weaknesses: Affinity predictions depend on input complex pose accuracy.

tools.name: Boltz-Perturb
tools.usage: Boltz-Perturb introduces a training-free perturbation protocol for open biomolecular co-folding models (Boltz-1/Boltz-2). It enhances conformational sampling diversity and pose accuracy for protein-ligand complexes without requiring expensive fine-tuning.
tools.strengths: Plug-and-play enhancement for open-source co-folding pipelines.
tools.weaknesses: Evaluated primarily on protein-ligand test suites.

tools.name: BoltzGen-1
tools.usage: BoltzGen-1 is an open generative protein design model hosted on HuggingFace Hub. Built on the open biomolecular representations of Boltz-1, BoltzGen-1 enables target-conditioned de novo binder generation across diverse biomolecular surfaces.
tools.strengths: Fully open model checkpoints for scalable binder candidate generation.
tools.weaknesses: Requires local execution environment or GPU inference container.

tools.name: HDOCK-Multimer
tools.usage: HDOCK-Multimer is an integrative computational method published on bioRxiv developed to overcome the GPU memory limits of end-to-end deep learning predictors (AlphaFold-Multimer, Boltz-1) when modeling massive macromolecular assemblies. By combining pairwise FFT-based docking, deep learning confidence metrics, and combinatorial tree-search assembly, HDOCK-Multimer accurately predicts the quaternary structure of large multimeric complexes containing dozens of protein subunits.
