tools.strengths: Allows researchers to model huge cellular machines and viral capsids that crash standard AlphaFold instances due to out-of-memory errors. Supports integration of sparse experimental restraints from cryo-EM density envelopes or cross-linking mass spectrometry.
tools.weaknesses: Does not model large-scale allosteric domain reorganizations that occur upon multimer assembly if subunits are docked as rigid bodies. Assembly accuracy depends heavily on the correctness of initial pairwise sub-complex predictions.

tools.name: NUMonomer
tools.usage: Accurate and scalable deep learning framework for RNA and DNA monomeric tertiary structure prediction.
tools.strengths: Superior tertiary base-pairing accuracy for non-canonical RNA motifs.
tools.weaknesses: Optimized primarily for nucleic acid components.

tools.name: IgGM2
tools.usage: All-atom generative foundation model for sequence-structure co-generation of antibodies, nanobodies, and TCRs.
tools.strengths: Specialized architecture for highly flexible immune CDR loops.
tools.weaknesses: Requires antigen target structure for binder conditioning.

tools.name: CASP17 & PDFBench
tools.usage: The 2026 global benchmark standard evaluating structure prediction and function-guided de novo protein design.
tools.strengths: Gold standard objective assessment across global AI structural biology teams.
tools.weaknesses: CASP target evaluations run on a biennial cycle.

tools.name: Pi-Ensemble
tools.usage: Pi-Ensemble (Predicting Interpolated Ensemble) is a sequence-guided generative framework developed by the Shukla Group that interpolates protein conformational ensembles between known anchor states (e.g., apo and holo) by iteratively alternating between inverse-folding and structure-prediction models without requiring task-specific retraining.
tools.strengths: Requires no custom neural network training or physical force field parameters to sample intermediate conformational states.
tools.weaknesses: Accuracy depends on the expressiveness of the underlying pretrained inverse-folding and structure prediction models.

tools.name: protein-frame-flow
tools.usage: protein-frame-flow is Microsoft Research's open-source framework implementing Riemannian Flow Matching directly on residue rigid-body frames SE(3) for ultra-fast, continuous-time generative protein backbone design.
tools.strengths: Fast and mathematically rigorous trajectory integration on rigid frames with high designability.
tools.weaknesses: Generates backbone coordinate frames; requires downstream sequence design (e.g. ProteinMPNN/LigandMPNN).

tools.name: la-proteina
tools.usage: la-proteina is an NVIDIA BioNeMo generative foundation model using partially latent flow matching for simultaneous, end-to-end co-generation of protein amino acid sequences and 3D atomic coordinates.
tools.strengths: Generates complete self-consistent sequence-structure pairs without external inverse-folding steps.
tools.weaknesses: Requires substantial GPU memory and BioNeMo dependencies for training and fine-tuning.

tools.name: RhoFold+
tools.usage: Published in Nature Methods, RhoFold+ is a deep learning foundation model that predicts RNA 3D tertiary structures directly from sequence and MSAs by coupling a pretrained RNA language model with an equivariant structural module.
tools.strengths: High accuracy on complex structured RNAs including riboswitches, aptamers, and viral RNA elements.
tools.weaknesses: Computational scaling challenges on very large (>1000 nt) multi-domain RNA complexes.

tools.name: AFM-LIS
tools.usage: AFM-LIS provides a specialized Local Interaction Score (LIS) algorithm that post-processes AlphaFold-Multimer PAE matrices and interfacial contact geometries to filter out false-positive protein-protein interactions.
tools.strengths: Substantially improves precision-recall curves on large-scale interactome screens.
tools.weaknesses: Designed specifically for multi-chain interfacial metrics; not applicable to single-chain folding.

tools.name: ProteinMPNN + ESMFold Interactive Co-Design Web Space on HuggingFace
tools.usage: An interactive, zero-installation HuggingFace Space developed by Simon Duerr that combines ProteinMPNN sequence generation with immediate real-time ESMFold 3D structure verification and 3Dmol.js rendering in the browser.
tools.strengths: Highly accessible, clean UI for rapid sequence generation and in-browser structural verification.
tools.weaknesses: Subject to HuggingFace Space compute quotas and memory limits on large proteins.

tools.name: Anatomy of BoltzGen
tools.usage: Anatomy of BoltzGen is an interpretability and visualization Space on HuggingFace that allows users to step through Boltz-1 all-atom generative diffusion trajectories and inspect internal pair representations.
tools.strengths: Exceptional educational and diagnostic tool for understanding diffusion-based structure generation.
tools.weaknesses: Interactive visualizer rather than a batch production pipeline.

tools.name: ESM3-PPISites
tools.usage: ESM3-PPISites is a specialized multimodal token classification model fine-tuned on top of ESM3 (EvolutionaryScale) by Area Science Park to predict protein-protein binding sites and interfacial contact residues directly from sequence and coordinates.
tools.strengths: Fast zero-shot-like interface prediction without requiring partner complex docking.
tools.weaknesses: Identifies binding potential of individual residues rather than specific partner pairings.

tools.name: Ovo
tools.usage: Published in Communications Biology (2026), Ovo is an open-source Python ecosystem designed to seamlessly unify structural generative diffusion models, inverse-folding networks, biophysical scoring, and automated filtering into reproducible protein design protocols.
tools.strengths: Greatly reduces software fragmentation and boilerplate code in protein engineering labs.
tools.weaknesses: Requires local installations of underlying deep learning packages.

tools.name: AI-Guided Competitive Docking for Proteome-Scale Virtual Screening & Efficacy
tools.usage: Published in npj Drug Discovery (2026), this framework introduces AI-guided competitive docking, simulating multi-ligand competition and allosteric displacement on AlphaFold-modeled receptor targets to dramatically improve virtual screening hit rates and rank relative compound efficacy.
tools.strengths: Significantly outperforms single-ligand docking scores in predicting functional pharmacological efficacy.
tools.weaknesses: Requires higher computational cost per target due to simultaneous multi-ligand sampling.

tools.name: CryoAtom2
tools.usage: CryoAtom2 is an inverse-folding inspired deep learning framework that automates atomic model building of complex protein-nucleic acid (DNA/RNA) assemblies directly from intermediate-to-high resolution cryo-EM density maps.
tools.strengths: Major leap forward for resolving complex ribonucleoprotein (RNP) machinery and viral complexes.
tools.weaknesses: Requires density maps with resolution better than ~4.0 Å for accurate atomic placement.
tools.github_description: Inverse Folding-Inspired Deep Learning for Protein-Nucleic Acid Model Building in Cryo-EM

tools.name: protein
tools.usage: protein-frame-flow is Microsoft Research's open-source framework implementing Riemannian Flow Matching directly on residue rigid-body frames SE(3) for ultra-fast, continuous-time generative protein backbone design.
tools.strengths: Fast and mathematically rigorous trajectory integration on rigid frames with high designability.
tools.weaknesses: Generates backbone coordinate frames; requires downstream sequence design (e.g. ProteinMPNN/LigandMPNN).
tools.github_description: frame-flow - SE(3) Riemannian Flow Matching for Fast Protein Backbone Generation

tools.name: BindEnergyCraft
tools.usage: Developed by researchers at MIT (Caroline Uhler, Divya Nori), BindEnergyCraft casts pre-trained protein structure prediction networks directly into energy-based generative models, guiding sequence generation toward high-affinity binding funnels.
tools.strengths: Principled biophysical framing that turns any forward structure predictor into an inverse design engine.
tools.weaknesses: Requires iterative gradient estimation during sampling, which increases design generation time.
tools.github_description: Casting Protein Structure Predictors as Energy-Based Models for Binder Design

tools.name: Covalent Co
tools.usage: A comprehensive benchmark study published in Acta Pharmacologica Sinica evaluating modern all-atom co-folding architectures (AlphaFold 3, Boltz-1, Chai-1) on the prediction of covalent protein-ligand and inhibitor complexes.
tools.strengths: Crucial independent evaluation for targeted covalent drug discovery programs.
tools.weaknesses: Dataset limited to currently solved covalent complexes in the PDB.
tools.github_description: Folding Benchmark - Systematic Evaluation of AF3, Boltz, & Chai on Covalent Complexes

tools.name: PPI
tools.usage: Published in Biomolecules, PPI-Diff introduces a resolution-aware geometric diffusion model specifically tailored for the de novo generation of flexible peptide binders against target protein surfaces.
tools.strengths: Tailored specifically for the unique conformational flexibility and entropy of therapeutic peptides.
tools.weaknesses: Assumes rigid target receptor backbone during peptide generation.
tools.github_description: Diff - De Novo Generation of Peptide Binders via Resolution-Aware Geometric Diffusion

tools.name: AbEgDiffuser
tools.usage: Published in the Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation, AbEgDiffuser is an end-to-end antibody design model that co-designs CDR loop sequences and 3D backbone/side-chain coordinates using equivariant graph neural networks coupled with continuous diffusion processes.
tools.strengths: Eliminates the error accumulation inherent in separate backbone generation and sequence design steps.
tools.weaknesses: Optimized for standard IgG variable domains (VH/VL) rather than general protein-protein complexes.
tools.github_description: Antibody Sequence-Structure Co-Design with Equivariant Graph Networks & Diffusion

tools.name: State
tools.usage: A methodology that introduces sequence-purification and pocket-context conditioning to AlphaFold 3, dramatically boosting its ability to predict alternative active/inactive conformational states and accurate ligand poses without training on holo structures.
tools.strengths: Directly enhances out-of-the-box AlphaFold 3 without requiring complete model retraining.
tools.weaknesses: Requires domain knowledge to identify relevant functional sequence masks or pocket definitions.
tools.github_description: Aware AF3 - Pocket & Sequence Purification for State-Specific Protein-Ligand Prediction

tools.name: Allosteric AI Framework
tools.usage: This bioRxiv preprint presents a dual computational framework that bridges all-atom AI co-folding models (AlphaFold 3, Chai-1, Boltz-1) with landscape-guided interpretable AI to decode allosteric communication pathways and induced-fit mechanisms in protein-ligand complexes.
tools.strengths: Resolves the long-standing disconnect between static deep-learning structures and dynamic allostery.
tools.weaknesses: Requires conformational sampling ensembles to construct accurate energy surfaces.
tools.github_description: Dual AI Framework Integrating Co-Folding with Energy Landscape Dynamics

tools.name: Genie 3
tools.usage: Genie 3 is a next-generation generative protein design architecture introducing atomistic SE(3)-equivariance for ultra-fast de novo protein backbone and full-atom generation, scaling effectively from small peptide binders to large macromolecular assemblies.
tools.strengths: State-of-the-art designability, novel topology generation, and high structural diversity.
tools.weaknesses: Experimental in vitro wet-lab validation required for each de novo target.
tools.github_description: Fast and Ultra-Capable Protein Design via Atomistic SE(3)-Equivariance

tools.name: MISATO ESM3 Conformational Sampling
tools.usage: An interactive HuggingFace Space developed by the MISATO team combining the generative multimodal ESM3 model with the MISATO dataset of quantum mechanics and molecular dynamics trajectories to sample and visualize protein conformational landscapes.
tools.strengths: Zero-installation interactive exploration of protein flexibility and metastable states.
tools.weaknesses: Web space compute limits sequence length and sample batch sizes.
tools.github_description: Interactive Protein Dynamics & Ensemble Explorer

tools.name: MCP_Chai1_Modal
tools.usage: MCP_Chai1_Modal is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server running Chai-1 on serverless Modal GPU infrastructure, designed to allow AI agents (such as Claude, Antigravity, and custom LLM copilots) to autonomously invoke all-atom protein, DNA, RNA, and ligand co-folding predictions.
tools.strengths: Empowers autonomous agentic workflows in computational structural biology and drug discovery.
tools.weaknesses: Requires Modal API backend or API credentials for serverless execution.
tools.github_description: Model Context Protocol Server for Agentic Chai-1 Biomolecular Co-Folding

tools.name: ESMC
tools.usage: ESMC-6B is the 6-billion parameter open-weights protein language foundation model developed by EvolutionaryScale and hosted on HuggingFace by CZ Biohub. It powers state-of-the-art zero-shot variant effect prediction, representation learning, and generative protein engineering.
tools.strengths: Gold-standard open foundation model for protein sequence embeddings and variant effect scoring.
tools.weaknesses: Requires multi-GPU setup (e.g. A100/H100) or quantization for local inference.
tools.github_description: 6B - EvolutionaryScale 6 Billion Parameter Foundation Protein Language Model

tools.name: FindMySequence
tools.usage: Developed at EMBL Hamburg, FindMySequence is a specialized structural bioinformatics tool that identifies and assigns protein sequences directly into unassigned cryo-EM density maps and X-ray crystallographic models using fragment-based sequence matching and structural alignment.
tools.strengths: Highly practical tool widely adopted in experimental cryo-EM and structural determination workflows.
tools.weaknesses: Requires initial backbone trace or C-alpha fragment coordinates from density maps.
tools.github_description: Sequence Identification & Assignment in Cryo-EM and Macromolecular Crystallography

tools.name: MolXProt
tools.usage: MolXProt is an open-source Python framework hosted on GitLab for predicting protein-ligand binding affinities. It couples molecular graph representations of small-molecule ligands with pre-trained ESM-2 protein language model sequence embeddings via bidirectional cross-attention mechanisms.
tools.strengths: Ultra-fast throughput suitable for screening multimillion-compound libraries against target proteins.
tools.weaknesses: Does not generate explicit 3D co-crystal coordinates (affinity regression focus).
tools.github_description: Lightweight Deep Learning Framework for Protein-Ligand Affinity via ESM-2 & Graph Cross-Attention

tools.name: bbflow - Flow Matching for Conformational Ensembles of Protein Backbones
tools.usage: Developed by the Gräter Lab (HITS / Heidelberg University), bbflow is a Riemannian SE(3) flow matching generative model designed to sample realistic conformational ensembles and transition pathways of protein backbones directly from sequence or reference states.
tools.strengths: Direct physical modeling of conformational dynamics without lengthy molecular dynamics simulations.
tools.weaknesses: Generates backbone coordinates; requires subsequent side-chain packing (e.g. via DLPacker or Rosetta).
tools.github_description: SE(3) Flow Matching for Generating Conformational Ensembles of Protein Backbones

tools.name: UniMoMo
tools.usage: UniMoMo is an ICML 2025 published framework for unified 3D generative modeling of biomolecular binders across diverse chemical modalities (peptides, macrocycles, and small-molecule ligands) with target structure conditioning.
tools.strengths: Bridges protein design and small-molecule medicinal chemistry into one unified paradigm.
tools.weaknesses: Focused on pocket-directed binder generation rather than de novo standalone scaffold generation.
tools.github_description: Unified Generative Modeling of 3D Molecules for De Novo Binder Design

tools.name: AnewOmni
tools.usage: AnewOmni is a unified all-atom generative modeling framework for biomolecular interactions. It formulates full-atom protein, peptide, small molecule, and antibody generation within continuous SE(3)-equivariant latent diffusion spaces, enabling co-design of multi-scale complex interfaces without rigid approximations.
tools.strengths: Highly versatile across modalities; achieves state-of-the-art contact recovery on all-atom binder design tasks.
tools.weaknesses: Requires high GPU memory for large multi-chain assemblies.
tools.github_description: All-Atom Latent Diffusion Generative Framework for Molecular, Peptide & Antibody Design

tools.name: RNAbpFlow
tools.usage: Published in Nature Methods (2026), RNAbpFlow implements SE(3) Riemannian Flow Matching augmented with explicit secondary-structure base-pairing constraints for accurate conditional and de novo 3D RNA tertiary structure generation.
tools.strengths: Solves the secondary-structure violation problem common in unconstrained biomolecular diffusion.
tools.weaknesses: Requires secondary structure dot-bracket or contact map specification for conditional mode.
tools.github_description: Base Pair-Augmented SE(3) Flow Matching for Conditional RNA 3D Generation

tools.name: Metadiffusion
tools.usage: Metadiffusion introduces an inference-time guidance algorithm that biases the reverse-time sampling trajectories of biomolecular diffusion models using physical meta-energy estimators, steering generated backbones toward biophysically favorable energy funnels without model retraining.
tools.strengths: Improves experimental design success rates without expensive architectural retraining.
tools.weaknesses: Adds gradient computation overhead during the reverse diffusion sampling loop.
tools.github_description: Inference-Time Meta-Energy Biasing of Biomolecular Diffusion Models

tools.name: ESM3
tools.usage: ESM3-PPISites is a specialized multimodal token classification model fine-tuned on top of ESM3 (EvolutionaryScale) by Area Science Park to predict protein-protein binding sites and interfacial contact residues directly from sequence and coordinates.
tools.strengths: Fast zero-shot-like interface prediction without requiring partner complex docking.
tools.weaknesses: Identifies binding potential of individual residues rather than specific partner pairings.
tools.github_description: PPISites - Multimodal Protein-Protein Interaction Site Predictor

tools.name: Anatomy of BoltzGen
tools.usage: Anatomy of BoltzGen is an interpretability and visualization Space on HuggingFace that allows users to step through Boltz-1 all-atom generative diffusion trajectories and inspect internal pair representations.
tools.strengths: Exceptional educational and diagnostic tool for understanding diffusion-based structure generation.
tools.weaknesses: Interactive visualizer rather than a batch production pipeline.
tools.github_description: Interactive Generative Structural Trajectory Explorer

tools.name: ProteinMPNN + ESMFold Interactive Co
tools.usage: An interactive, zero-installation HuggingFace Space developed by Simon Duerr that combines ProteinMPNN sequence generation with immediate real-time ESMFold 3D structure verification and 3Dmol.js rendering in the browser.
tools.strengths: Highly accessible, clean UI for rapid sequence generation and in-browser structural verification.
tools.weaknesses: Subject to HuggingFace Space compute quotas and memory limits on large proteins.
tools.github_description: Design Web Space on HuggingFace

tools.name: HuIntAF2
tools.usage: Developed by the Elofsson Lab, HuIntAF2 provides comprehensive datasets, scoring scripts, and predicted 3D interface models for the human protein-protein interactome modeled via AlphaFold2 and AlphaFold-Multimer.
tools.strengths: Gold-standard reference database for human structural interactomics.
tools.weaknesses: Static database focusing on binary human protein pairs.
tools.github_description: Human Protein-Protein Interactome and Interface Map by AlphaFold2

tools.name: BioVoice
tools.usage: BioVoice is an innovative accessibility and productivity framework hosted on GitLab providing real-time voice and natural language control for macromolecular visualization tools, including PyMOL and UCSF ChimeraX. Built for structural biologists working at wet-lab benches or sterile hoods who cannot easily use a mouse and keyboard, BioVoice translates spoken directives into exact structural selections, colorings, distance measurements, and AlphaFold structure alignments.
tools.strengths: Enables seamless hands-free structural inspection during experimental protocols, lab meetings, and virtual reality demonstrations. Compatible with both Linux and Windows workstations running PyMOL or ChimeraX.
tools.weaknesses: Background laboratory noise or non-standard accents may require microphone calibration. Grammar parsing is optimized for structural manipulation commands rather than general biochemical dialog.
tools.github_description: Voice Control & Real-Time Agent Tool Calling for AlphaFold, PyMOL, and Rosetta

tools.name: AFM
tools.usage: AFM-LIS provides a specialized Local Interaction Score (LIS) algorithm that post-processes AlphaFold-Multimer PAE matrices and interfacial contact geometries to filter out false-positive protein-protein interactions.
tools.strengths: Substantially improves precision-recall curves on large-scale interactome screens.
tools.weaknesses: Designed specifically for multi-chain interfacial metrics; not applicable to single-chain folding.
tools.github_description: LIS - Local Interaction Score for AlphaFold-Multimer Interface Confidence Estimation

tools.name: CarsiDock
tools.usage: CarsiDock is a deep learning docking platform developed by CarbonSilicon AI that incorporates pocket-conditioned representations and torsion-angle optimization for high-accuracy small-molecule pose prediction on AlphaFold-derived targets.
tools.strengths: Robust performance even on flexible, unrefined AlphaFold modeled binding pockets.
tools.weaknesses: Requires prior pocket identification or bounding box specification.
tools.github_description: Pocket-Conditioned Deep Learning Paradigm for Accurate Protein-Ligand Docking

tools.name: dyMEAN
tools.usage: dyMEAN is an end-to-end full-atom antibody design framework that models dynamic atomic interactions between CDR loops and antigen epitopes using hierarchical dynamic mean-field message passing.
tools.strengths: Simultaneous sequence-structure antibody design with explicit full-atom biophysical packing.
tools.weaknesses: Requires high-resolution 3D coordinates of the target antigen epitope.
tools.github_description: Dynamic Mean-Field Network for End-to-End Full-Atom Antibody Design

tools.name: AlphaFast
tools.usage: AlphaFast from the Romero Lab introduces a GPU-accelerated multiple sequence alignment pipeline tailored for AlphaFold 3, cutting end-to-end inference bottlenecks by over 10-fold for massive screening campaigns.
tools.strengths: GPU-parallelized sequence search and alignment replacing slow CPU routines, eliminating the primary throughput bottleneck in AlphaFold 3.
tools.weaknesses: Requires large dedicated GPU VRAM for in-memory database indexing.
tools.github_description: Ultra-High-Throughput AlphaFold 3 Inference with MMSeqs2-GPU Acceleration

tools.name: AF3Score
tools.usage: AF3Score is a score-only adaptation of the AlphaFold 3 architecture developed to evaluate and rank input biomolecular complex structures (proteins, nucleic acids, ligands) without running full iterative coordinate diffusion.
tools.strengths: Fast, high-fidelity ranking function for virtual screening libraries and generative design decoys.
tools.weaknesses: Does not refine or generate new coordinates; evaluates input candidate poses.
tools.github_description: Score-Only Adaptation of AlphaFold 3 for Biomolecular Quality Evaluation

tools.name: RhoFold+
tools.usage: Published in Nature Methods, RhoFold+ is a deep learning foundation model that predicts RNA 3D tertiary structures directly from sequence and MSAs by coupling a pretrained RNA language model with an equivariant structural module.
tools.strengths: High accuracy on complex structured RNAs including riboswitches, aptamers, and viral RNA elements.
tools.weaknesses: Computational scaling challenges on very large (>1000 nt) multi-domain RNA complexes.
tools.github_description: Foundation RNA Language Model for Accurate 3D Tertiary Structure Prediction

tools.name: BioPhi
tools.usage: Automated Antibody Humanization, Humanness Evaluation & Sequence Design Platform
tools.strengths: Extensively validated experimentally in pharma lead optimization; accessible web UI and CLI.
tools.weaknesses: Focused primarily on IgG variable domains (VH/VL) rather than non-antibody protein scaffolds.
tools.github_description: Automated Antibody Humanization, Humanness Evaluation & Sequence Design Platform

tools.name: PPIscreenML
tools.usage: Machine Learning-Guided High-Throughput Screening of Protein-Protein Interactions with AlphaFold
tools.strengths: Makes genome-wide structural interactome screening feasible on standard academic GPU clusters.
tools.weaknesses: Requires initial sequence co-evolution data for optimal filtering.
tools.github_description: Machine Learning-Guided High-Throughput Screening of Protein-Protein Interactions with AlphaFold

tools.name: PLIP 2025
tools.usage: High-Throughput Non-Covalent Interaction Profiler for AlphaFold Predicted Complexes
tools.strengths: Gold standard for automated, rule-based non-covalent interaction characterization in structural biology.
tools.weaknesses: Relies on geometric threshold cutoffs rather than quantum-mechanical contact energetics.
tools.github_description: High-Throughput Non-Covalent Interaction Profiler for AlphaFold Predicted Complexes

tools.name: IgLM
tools.usage: Synthetic Antibody Library Generation and Sequence-Structure Co-Design with Generative Language Models
tools.strengths: Computationally lightweight and fast for generating hundreds of thousands of candidate antibody sequences.
tools.weaknesses: Requires downstream structural filtering (e.g. via AlphaFold-Multimer or Rosetta) for target-specific binding.
tools.github_description: Synthetic Antibody Library Generation and Sequence-Structure Co-Design with Generative Language Models

tools.name: Computational De Novo Design of Broad
tools.usage: Spectrum Neutralizing Proteins for Lethal Snake Toxins
tools.strengths: Flawless experimental proof of generative protein design translating into life-saving therapeutics.
tools.weaknesses: Targeting diverse venom families required separate epitope scaffolding protocols.
tools.github_description: Spectrum Neutralizing Proteins for Lethal Snake Toxins

tools.name: Phyre2.2
tools.usage: Community Platform Integrating AlphaFold Models, Evolutionary Profiles, and Variant Scoring
tools.strengths: Extremely user-friendly for experimental biologists without bioinformatics command-line infrastructure.
tools.weaknesses: Custom multi-chain complexes require separate advanced modeling pipelines.
tools.github_description: Community Platform Integrating AlphaFold Models, Evolutionary Profiles, and Variant Scoring

tools.name: DiffAbXL
tools.usage: Generative Joint Heavy-Light Chain Diffusion & Log-Likelihood Ranking for Binders
tools.strengths: Addresses the critical pairing problem between heavy and light chains in generative antibody design.
tools.weaknesses: Requires high computational budget for multi-step reverse diffusion sampling.
tools.github_description: Generative Joint Heavy-Light Chain Diffusion & Log-Likelihood Ranking for Binders

tools.name: Memorisation vs Generalisation in Biomolecular Co
tools.usage: Folding - Evaluating PDB Leakage in AF3, Boltz, and Chai
tools.strengths: Crucial foundational theoretical study clarifying the boundaries of AI-driven structural drug discovery.
tools.weaknesses: Focuses on protein-small molecule complexes; nucleic acid generalization was tested separately.
tools.github_description: Folding - Evaluating PDB Leakage in AF3, Boltz, and Chai

tools.name: MISATO Protein Dynamics
tools.usage: Deep Learning Residue Flexibility & Conformational Ensemble Explorer
tools.strengths: Bypasses microsecond-long explicit solvent MD simulations to get dynamic flexibility profiles in seconds.
tools.weaknesses: Focuses on conformational fluctuations around equilibrium states rather than large-scale unfolding.
tools.github_description: Deep Learning Residue Flexibility & Conformational Ensemble Explorer

tools.name: af2wrapper
tools.usage: Cluster Job Execution & MSA Management Wrapper for AlphaFold2, ColabFold, and OpenFold
tools.strengths: Eliminates repetitive cluster job script configuration and optimizes MSA storage overhead on shared supercomputers.
tools.weaknesses: Designed primarily for Linux HPC cluster/SLURM environments.
tools.github_description: Cluster Job Execution & MSA Management Wrapper for AlphaFold2, ColabFold, and OpenFold

tools.name: AVOIDRUNE
tools.usage: Automated Viral Structural Modeling & Immune Evasion Docking Workflow
tools.strengths: Highly reproducible, modular architecture tailored for viral epidemiology and antibody resistance monitoring.
tools.weaknesses: Geared primarily towards viral surface glycoproteins and antibody-antigen complexes.
tools.github_description: Automated Viral Structural Modeling & Immune Evasion Docking Workflow

tools.name: NeuralPLexer
tools.usage: State-Specific Protein-Ligand Complex Structure Prediction with Deep Generative Models
tools.strengths: Accurately predicts induced-fit rearrangements that traditional rigid docking engines miss.
tools.weaknesses: Inference time is higher than classical fast docking programs like AutoDock Vina.
tools.github_description: State-Specific Protein-Ligand Complex Structure Prediction with Deep Generative Models

tools.name: PoseBench
tools.usage: Standardized Benchmark for Protein-Ligand Co-Folding & Docking Models
tools.strengths: Nature Machine Intelligence published; unbiased direct comparison across classical vs deep learning docking algorithms.
tools.weaknesses: Requires substantial local compute or containerized environments to run all 10+ benchmarked docking engines.
tools.github_description: Standardized Benchmark for Protein-Ligand Co-Folding & Docking Models

tools.name: RAPID
tools.usage: Published in JCIM (2026), RAPID-Net is an ultra-fast deep learning framework for blind binding pocket detection and druggability scoring directly on predicted AlphaFold structures, enabling proteome-scale ligand docking.
tools.strengths: Ideal preprocessing engine for large-scale AlphaFold-based virtual screening campaigns.
tools.weaknesses: Accuracy can be influenced by low-confidence flexible loop regions surrounding the pocket.
tools.github_description: Net - Accurate Pocket Identification for Binding-Site-Agnostic Docking

tools.name: SAKE
tools.usage: Published in JACS Au (2026), SAKE-PP is a spatial-attention SE(3)-equivariant neural network designed to score, rank, and identify native-like protein-protein interaction complexes from large AlphaFold-Multimer and docking decoy ensembles.
tools.strengths: Significantly improves identification of top-scoring native-like complex models from ensemble runs.
tools.weaknesses: Requires atomic coordinate inputs for both protein partners; trained primarily on binary complexes.
tools.github_description: PP - Spatial-Attention Equivariant Network for PPI Model Ranking

tools.name: PRosettaC Outperforms AlphaFold3 for Modeling PROTAC Ternary Complexes
tools.usage: A benchmark paper in Scientific Reports demonstrating that physics-based PRosettaC protocol with ensemble conformational sampling achieves higher accuracy than pure end-to-end AlphaFold 3 on challenging PROTAC ternary complexes with unconstrained linkers.
tools.strengths: Demonstrates the continuing necessity of physics-based refinement alongside deep learning.
tools.weaknesses: Requires multi-step Rosetta sampling pipelines which are slower than single-pass AI inference.
tools.github_description: PRosettaC Outperforms AlphaFold3 for Modeling PROTAC Ternary Complexes

tools.name: AI Prediction of PROTAC & Molecular Glue Ternary Complexes
tools.usage: A rigorous 2026 comparative evaluation study in Archiv der Pharmazie investigating the capabilities and failure modes of all-atom AI models (AlphaFold 3, Boltz-2) in predicting ternary degradation complexes formed by PROTACs and molecular glues.
tools.strengths: Highly relevant for targeted protein degradation (TPD) drug discovery programs.
tools.weaknesses: AI models still struggle with highly flexible, extended PROTAC linkers in solution.
tools.github_description: AF3 vs Boltz-2

tools.name: Continuous Automated Model EvaluatiOn (CAMEO) for Macromolecular Complexes
tools.usage: The landmark 2026 CAMEO (Continuous Automated Model EvaluatiOn) complex evaluation benchmark paper in Proteins, tracking blind weekly structure predictions for multi-chain assemblies and biomolecular complexes across AlphaFold, ColabFold, ESMFold, and RoseTTAFold servers.
tools.strengths: Gold-standard independent blind benchmark free from post-hoc test dataset contamination.
tools.weaknesses: Limited to publicly submitted automated server pipelines registered with the CAMEO platform.
tools.github_description: Continuous Automated Model EvaluatiOn (CAMEO) for Macromolecular Complexes

tools.name: A Generalisable Framework to Inject Distance Restraints into AlphaFold
tools.usage: A mathematical and algorithmic framework that allows experimental cross-linking mass spectrometry (XL-MS), NMR NOE, and FRET distance restraints to be directly injected into pair representations of AlphaFold, Boltz-1, and Chai-1 architectures.
tools.strengths: Directly empowers integrative structural biology by combining experimental low-resolution data with AI.
tools.weaknesses: Restraint quality matters; conflicting or noisy experimental restraints can degrade prediction quality.
tools.github_description: Like Predictors

tools.name: Constrained Generative Design for Discovery of Target
tools.usage: A generative diffusion modeling framework with geometric constraints tailored specifically to repeat protein scaffolds (Designed Ankyrin Repeat Proteins / DARPins), enabling de novo binder generation against challenging therapeutic targets.
tools.strengths: Extends deep-learning generative binder design to non-antibody modular repeat protein formats.
tools.weaknesses: Focused primarily on ankyrin repeat architecture; custom parameters needed for other repeat classes.
tools.github_description: Specific DARPin Candidates

tools.name: SPLISOFORMS
tools.usage: SPLISOFORMS is an AlphaFold-driven structural knowledgebase mapping the conformational and domain-level impacts of alternative transcript splicing across the human proteome, cataloging isoform-specific folding, disordered transitions, and lost binding interfaces.
tools.strengths: Fills a major gap in structural biology by extending structural models beyond canonical UniProt references.
tools.weaknesses: Predicted confidence for non-canonical isoforms can vary depending on evolutionary MSA depth.
tools.github_description: A Structure-Resolved Knowledge Base of Alternative Splicing Isoforms

tools.name: Characterising AlphaFold 3's Ability to Predict T Cell Antigen Specificity
tools.usage: A comprehensive benchmark rigorously evaluating AlphaFold 3's capability to model T cell receptor (TCR) binding to peptide-major histocompatibility complexes (pMHC), investigating whether AF3 structural confidence correlates with antigen discrimination and cross-reactivity.
tools.strengths: Provides much-needed quantitative clarity on using AlphaFold 3 in computational immunology and TCR design.
tools.weaknesses: Finds that AF3 alone cannot replace experimental binding validation for borderline affinity TCRs.
tools.github_description: Characterising AlphaFold 3's Ability to Predict T Cell Antigen Specificity

tools.name: Chai
tools.usage: Official model repository for Chai-1, a multi-modal biomolecular foundation model for all-atom structure prediction. Chai-1 models protein-protein, protein-ligand, protein-nucleic acid complexes and antibody-antigen interfaces with restraint-guided inference support.
tools.strengths: Free non-commercial inference weights with flexible restraint-guided modeling capabilities.
tools.weaknesses: All-atom diffusion inference can require significant GPU memory for very large assemblies.
tools.github_description: 1 - Multi-Modal Biomolecular Foundation Model on HuggingFace

tools.name: ESM3 (esm3
tools.usage: ESM3 is EvolutionaryScale's multimodal generative protein foundation model. It simultaneously reasons across sequence, 3D structure, and secondary structure/function tracks, enabling generative protein prompting, scaffold infilling, and complex structural generation.
tools.strengths: True multimodal protein intelligence capable of generating novel functional proteins from prompts.
tools.weaknesses: Large model size requires modern GPU hardware with bfloat16 / FlashAttention support.
tools.github_description: sm-open-v1) - Frontier Multimodal Generative Protein Model

tools.name: Cradle Studio Client
tools.usage: The official GitLab client repository for Cradle Bio's protein engineering platform, providing Python SDKs and CLI utilities for programmatic generative design, stability optimization, affinity maturation, and iterative laboratory round tracking.
tools.strengths: Bridges industrial protein engineering pipelines directly into automated code workflows.
tools.weaknesses: Requires API credentials / workspace access on Cradle Bio's platform.
tools.github_description: Programmable API & SDK for Generative Protein Engineering

tools.name: CmDock
tools.usage: CmDock is a modern, modular, cross-platform fork of the RxDock molecular docking software engine, optimized for high-throughput virtual screening, cavity mapping, and scoring protein-ligand complexes predicted by AlphaFold and AI structural tools.
tools.strengths: Extremely fast screening throughput with comprehensive pocket-scoring customization.
tools.weaknesses: Requires ligand prep in Mol2/SDF format with proper formal charge and protonation states.
tools.github_description: High-Performance Cross-Platform Structural Docking & Virtual Screening

tools.name: AntiFold
tools.usage: AntiFold is an antibody-tailored inverse folding model developed by the Oxford Protein Informatics Group (OPIG). It designs amino acid sequences conditioned on antibody backbone structures (including AlphaFold and ESMFold predictions), outperforming general-purpose models on CDR loops.
tools.strengths: State-of-the-art sequence design accuracy specifically calibrated for antibody CDR engineering.
tools.weaknesses: Optimized specifically for immunoglobulin folds; not suitable for non-antibody structural scaffolds.
tools.github_description: Deep Learning Inverse Folding Model Dedicated to Antibody Design

tools.name: IPSAE
tools.usage: IPSAE (Interface Predicted Aligned Error) is a structural analysis toolkit developed by the Dunbrack Lab to extract, score, and visualize inter-chain confidence metrics from AlphaFold-Multimer and ColabFold PAE matrices, identifying high-confidence docking interfaces.
tools.strengths: Essential diagnostic tool for distinguishing real protein-protein interfaces from docking artifacts.
tools.weaknesses: Relies on PAE matrix outputs; cannot re-score structural models lacking predicted aligned error data.
tools.github_description: Interface Predicted Aligned Error Analysis for AlphaFold-Multimer Decoys

tools.name: FoldFlow
tools.usage: FoldFlow is an open-source framework by DreamFold implementing Riemannian Flow Matching directly on the SE(3) manifold for continuous-time generative protein backbone design, offering straight generative trajectories and faster sampling than standard diffusion models.
tools.strengths: Fast, high-diversity backbone generation with rigorous geometric grounding.
tools.weaknesses: Focuses on backbone generation; requires downstream sequence inverse-folding (e.g. ProteinMPNN).
tools.github_description: Riemannian Flow Matching on SE(3) for Generative Protein Backbone Design

tools.name: SaProt
tools.usage: SaProt is a universal structure-aware protein language model trained on Foldseek structural alphabet tokens. It incorporates 3D geometric context directly into sequence representations, excelling at zero-shot variant effect prediction, protein design, and structure alignment.
tools.strengths: Directly bridges sequence and structural representations with standard Transformer inference speed.
tools.weaknesses: Requires structural tokens (Foldseek 3Di) generated from coordinate files for full performance.
tools.github_description: Universal Structure-Aware Protein Language Model for Variant Effect & Design

tools.name: AntiConf
tools.usage: Novel evaluation metric and confidence scoring tool (AntiConf) published in Briefings in Bioinformatics tailored specifically for validating deep learning-predicted antibody-antigen complex structures.
tools.strengths: Prevents false positive candidate selection in antibody engineering pipelines.
tools.weaknesses: Specific to antibody-antigen interfaces.
tools.github_description: Precision Confidence Scoring Metric for Antibody-Antigen Predictions

tools.name: Pocket Restraints Guided by Epitope Prediction Improve Chai
tools.usage: Publication in Protein Science demonstrating that integrating sequence-based B-cell epitope prediction as distance restraints significantly improves Chai-1 antibody-antigen complex docking pose prediction.
tools.strengths: Easy to integrate into existing Chai-1 inference runs.
tools.weaknesses: Relies on accuracy of upstream epitope predictor.
tools.github_description: 1 Docking

tools.name: Benchmarking Nanobody
tools.usage: Systematic benchmark in Protein Engineering Design and Selection assessing the accuracy of state-of-the-art co-folding models (AlphaFold 3, Boltz-1, Chai-1) for nanobody-small molecule complex prediction.
tools.strengths: Provides objective accuracy metrics for antibody/nanobody engineering.
tools.weaknesses: Limited dataset size of high-resolution experimental nanobody-small molecule structures.
tools.github_description: Small Molecule Complex Structure Predictions

tools.name: HANSEN Proteome Resource
tools.usage: HANSEN is an integrated proteome resource combining AlphaFold DB structural models and functional annotations to drive target identification and drug discovery in Mycobacterium leprae.
tools.strengths: Comprehensive structural coverage for an unculturable bacterial pathogen.
tools.weaknesses: Focuses on M. leprae proteome specifically.
tools.github_description: Structure-Guided Target Discovery in M. leprae

tools.name: Seed
tools.usage: Seed-guided generative design methodology that leverages small structural seeds to dramatically expand structural diversity and affinity in de novo antitoxin protein binder campaigns.
tools.strengths: Bypasses local minimum traps of pure unconstrained de novo generation.
tools.weaknesses: Requires initial structural identification of seed contact residues.
tools.github_description: Guided De Novo Design - Expanding Structural Diversity of Antitoxin Binders

tools.name: BioPipelines
tools.usage: BioPipelines provides a user-friendly, end-to-end computational protein and ligand design environment integrating ESMFold, RFdiffusion, and PyRosetta for bench scientists.
tools.strengths: Lowers barriers to entry for experimentalists running computational design campaigns.
tools.weaknesses: Wrapper overhead compared to raw CLI execution.
tools.github_description: Accessible Protein & Ligand Design Suite for Chemical Biology

tools.name: Boltz
tools.usage: Interactive Gradio Space on HuggingFace providing no-code browser-based access to Boltz-1 biomolecular co-folding, multi-chain prediction, and ligand docking.
tools.strengths: Accessible immediately in web browser without hardware requirements.
tools.weaknesses: Subject to HuggingFace free Space queue limits for large jobs.
tools.github_description: 1 Interactive Web Server - Zero-Setup Co-Folding Space on HuggingFace

tools.name: ESMFold & ESMFold2 Model Family
tools.usage: The ESMFold and ESMFold2 model families hosted on HuggingFace Hub provide instant single-sequence structure predictions powered by ESM language models, bypassing MSA computation.
tools.strengths: Fastest inference speed for single protein sequences with open HuggingFace API.
tools.weaknesses: Lower accuracy on complex multi-chain oligomers compared to MSA-based co-folding.
tools.github_description: Fast Single-Sequence Predictors on HuggingFace

tools.name: LightDock
tools.usage: LightDock is a multiscale docking framework based on Glowworm Swarm Optimization for modeling protein-protein, protein-peptide, and protein-nucleic acid complexes with backbone and sidechain flexibility.
tools.strengths: Handles flexible docking scenarios and nucleic acid complexes effectively.
tools.weaknesses: Computationally intensive for large multi-chain assemblies.
tools.github_description: Multiscale Flexible Macromolecular Docking Framework

tools.name: PyRosetta Notebooks
tools.usage: Official Jupyter Notebooks suite from RosettaCommons providing interactive tutorials and production workflows for PyRosetta biomolecular modeling, interface design, ligand docking, and integration with deep-learning generative tools.
tools.strengths: Gold standard for biophysical refinement, sidechain packing, and energetic analysis.
tools.weaknesses: Requires PyRosetta academic/commercial license for underlying library.
tools.github_description: Interactive Biomolecular Modeling & Machine-Learning Design Workflows

tools.name: MolecularNodes
tools.usage: MolecularNodes is an open-source Blender add-on powered by Geometry Nodes for importing, rendering, and animating biomolecular structures predicted by AlphaFold, ESMFold, and RosettaFold, as well as PDB/mmCIF files and MD trajectories.
tools.strengths: Ultra-high quality rendering and animation capabilities unmatched by classical molecular viewers.
tools.weaknesses: Requires Blender 3.x+ and basic familiarity with 3D animation nodes.
tools.github_description: Geometry Nodes Molecular Animation & Structure Visualizer in Blender

tools.name: BioEmu
tools.usage: Biomolecular Emulator from Microsoft Research directly sampling protein equilibrium structural ensembles and cryptic pockets from sequence.
tools.strengths: Captures functional conformational changes and cryptic pocket opening orders of magnitude faster than MD.
tools.weaknesses: Focuses on equilibrium conformational dynamics rather than all-atom multimer docking.
tools.github_description: BioEmu: Sampling protein equilibrium structural ensembles directly from amino acid sequences.

tools.name: HelixFold-3
tools.usage: All-atom biomolecular structure prediction model developed by Baidu PaddleHelix for protein, RNA, DNA, and ligand complexes.
tools.strengths: High efficiency and optimized distributed inference on GPU clusters.
tools.weaknesses: Requires PaddlePaddle deep learning framework ecosystem.
tools.github_description: HelixFold-3: All-atom biomolecular structure prediction model.

tools.name: xfold
tools.usage: PyTorch reimplementation of AlphaFold 3 designed for fast training and inference acceleration.
tools.strengths: Clean PyTorch codebase with native GPU acceleration and modular design.
tools.weaknesses: Community project focusing primarily on core inference reproducibility.
tools.github_description: Democratizing AlphaFold3: a PyTorch reimplementation to accelerate protein structure prediction.

tools.name: ABCFold
tools.usage: ABCFold is a unified Python framework and CLI tool from the Rigden Lab that streamlines the setup, execution, cross-comparison, and consensus analysis of modern all-atom biomolecular structure predictors: AlphaFold 3, Boltz-1, and Chai-1.
tools.strengths: Unified input schema accepting FASTA, SMILES, and stoichiometries; automated side-by-side metric computation and consensus ranking.
tools.weaknesses: Requires local or API installations for all three underlying prediction engines.
tools.github_description: ABCFold: easier running and comparison of AlphaFold 3, Boltz-1 and Chai-1.

tools.name: FK-RFdiffusion
tools.usage: Feynman-Kac steering framework for controllable protein diffusion trajectories.
tools.strengths: Enables mathematically rigorous guidance without model retraining.
tools.weaknesses: Adds computational overhead to diffusion step sampling.
tools.github_description: Feynman-Kac steering for controllable protein diffusion.

tools.name: ROCKET
tools.usage: Refining OpenFold / AlphaFold predictions with Cryo-EM, Cryo-ET, and Crystallographic Likelihood Targets.
tools.strengths: Published in Nature Methods 2026; optimizes structures within coevolutionary embedding space without Cartesian distortion.
tools.weaknesses: Requires experimental density maps or diffraction targets.
tools.github_description: AlphaFold as a prior: experimental structure determination conditioned on a pretrained neural network.

tools.name: AF2chi
tools.usage: Predicts protein side-chain chi-angle rotamer distributions and conformational ensembles directly from AlphaFold 2 internal representations.
tools.strengths: Reveals subtle side-chain dynamics and rotamer heterogeneity without MD simulations.
tools.weaknesses: Focuses on side-chain conformational degrees of freedom.
tools.github_description: AF2chi: Predicting protein side-chain rotamer distributions with AlphaFold2.

tools.name: AlphaJudge
tools.usage: Evaluates AlphaFold-predicted protein complexes combining AI confidence metrics with physics-based interface features.
tools.strengths: Combines ipTM, pDockQ, and PAE with interfacial area, energy, and electrostatics in a unified CSV report.
tools.weaknesses: Designed primarily for multi-chain complex scoring.
tools.github_description: AlphaJudge: Unified evaluation of AlphaFold protein complex predictions.

tools.name: Boltzina
tools.usage: Efficient and accurate virtual screening platform via docking-guided binding prediction with Boltz-2.
tools.strengths: High-throughput screening efficiency for large chemical libraries with all-atom co-folding accuracy.
tools.weaknesses: Requires ligand SMILES / 3D conformer prep.
tools.github_description: Boltzina: Efficient and Accurate Virtual Screening via Docking-Guided Binding Prediction with Boltz-2.

tools.name: protein-mcp-server
tools.usage: Federated structural biology Model Context Protocol (MCP) server bridging experimental (PDB) and predicted (AlphaFold DB) models for AI agents.
tools.strengths: Supports STDIO and Streamable HTTP for Antigravity IDE, Claude, and Cursor.
tools.weaknesses: Requires MCP-compatible agent environment.
tools.github_description: Federated protein structure & annotation across PDB and AlphaFold via MCP.

tools.name: PDBe-MCP-Servers
tools.usage: Official Protein Data Bank Europe MCP server integrating PDB & AlphaFold DB knowledge graphs with LLMs.
tools.strengths: Provides Cypher query assistance and rich structural metadata retrieval.
tools.weaknesses: Focused on PDBe knowledge graph queries.
tools.github_description: PDBe MCP Servers integrate Protein Data Bank Europe resources with LLMs via Model Context Protocol.

tools.name: PyMissense
tools.usage: Generates AlphaMissense pathogenicity heatmaps and colored 3D PDB structures for custom proteins and sequences.
tools.strengths: Developed at Max Planck Institute Dortmund; provides ready-to-publish mutation maps.
tools.weaknesses: Depends on local AlphaMissense dataset files.
tools.github_description: PyMissense creates pathogenicity plots and modified PDBs from AlphaMissense.

tools.name: ProtSpace
tools.usage: Interactive client-side WebGL browser tool for exploring protein language model embeddings with AlphaFold structural annotation overlays.
tools.strengths: Zero-upload, fast browser-based 3D UMAP visualization and annotation transfer.
tools.weaknesses: Client-side memory limited to ~50k embeddings in browser.
tools.github_description: Explore protein language model embeddings and AlphaFold annotations in your browser.

tools.name: GeomMotif
tools.usage: Systematic benchmarking framework evaluating arbitrary 3D geometric motif scaffolding preservation in protein generative models across 57 PDB tasks.
tools.strengths: Evaluates motif preservation independently of functional constraints using scRMSD, pLDDT, and structural diversity metrics.
tools.weaknesses: Focuses on structural fragment fidelity rather than wet-lab binding affinity.
tools.full_citation: Strashnov P., Shevtsov A., Meshchaninov V., Kardymon O., & Vetrov D. (2026). GeomMotif: A Benchmark for Arbitrary Geometric Preservation in Protein Generation. *ICLR*.
tools.github_description: GeomMotif repository.

tools.name: LiteMol-1
tools.usage: Generative foundation model for multi-modal molecular design: small molecules, linear/cyclic peptides, non-canonical amino acids, depsipeptides, macrocycles, PROTACs. Supports unconditional generation or protein-conditioned generation, property-steered sampling, and multi-objective optimization via Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS).
tools.strengths: Single model covering diverse molecular modalities; protein-conditioned generation; MCTS-based multi-objective optimization maintaining Pareto-optimal candidates; supports medicinal chemistry design loop
tools.weaknesses: No peer-reviewed publication yet; limited independent benchmarking; primarily accessible via LiteFold platform (litefold.in)

tools.name: OpenBind-0
tools.usage: Fully open protein-ligand co-folding model built on OpenFold3. Predicts protein-small molecule complex structures. Introduces inference-time chemical steering for improved ligand physical validity. Trained on PDB data through June 2025. Evaluated via Runs N Poses benchmark.
tools.strengths: Fully open weights and datasets; built on OpenFold3 architecture; inference-time chemical steering; released with 717-structure experimental dataset spanning three drug targets; clean benchmark design (no leakage into training)
tools.weaknesses: Model v0 baseline quality; no published peer-reviewed paper yet; primarily focused on small molecules (not macrocycles or other modalities)

tools.name: Pair-Representation-Scaling
tools.journal: Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling (JCIM)
tools.usage: Pair-Representation-Scaling is a computational framework published in JCIM 2026 that introduces systematic scaling and perturbation of Pairformer/Pair-representation tensors in AlphaFold 3 and Boltz-2 to sample distinct functional conformational states, active/inactive transitions, and cryptic binding pockets.
tools.strengths: Fast, gradient-free method to explore the conformational landscape of flexible macromolecules directly within modern all-atom predictors without MSA subsampling.
tools.weaknesses: Requires careful calibration of scaling coefficients to avoid generating non-physical unfolded intermediates.

tools.name: fast_trimul
tools.usage: fast_trimul is an open-source, high-performance library providing drop-in fused CUDA/CUTLASS kernels for Triangle Multiplicative Updates across AlphaFold3-family models (AlphaFold 3, OpenFold-3, Boltz, Protenix), drastically cutting GPU memory bandwidth and inference latency.
tools.strengths: Hardware-optimized fused Triangle Multiplicative Update kernels in CUTLASS CuTe DSL, reducing peak VRAM and providing 2x-3x speedup on modern NVIDIA GPUs.
tools.weaknesses: Requires NVIDIA GPU with CUDA compute capability >= 8.0.

tools.name: NetTCRfold-1.0
tools.usage: NetTCRfold-1.0 is an automated pipeline and specialized modeling protocol for high-confidence 3D structure prediction of T-cell receptor–peptide-MHC (TCR-pMHC) complexes using AlphaFold3, developed by the Nielsen Lab.
tools.strengths: Domain-tailored sequence formatting and paired MSA construction specifically optimized for TCR alpha/beta chains and MHC alleles.
tools.weaknesses: Accuracy remains sensitive to atypical ultra-long CDR3 beta loop conformations.

tools.name: BindMOL
tools.usage: BindMOL is an open-source browser-based local GUI interface designed for structural biology workstations, integrating RFdiffusion, ProteinMPNN, AlphaFold 3, and Rosetta into an intuitive end-to-end binder design canvas.
tools.strengths: Democratizes complex command-line binder design workflows with interactive pocket selection, automated execution, and 3D Mol* visualization.
tools.weaknesses: Requires local Linux workstation setup with GPU.

tools.name: fold-agent
tools.usage: fold-agent is an autonomous multi-agent platform for protein science featuring 9 specialized research modes and 14 structural prediction backends (AlphaFold2/3, ColabFold, ESMFold, Boltz, OpenFold, Chai-1, RFdiffusion) with safety-gated execution and FastAPI orchestration.
tools.strengths: Extensible agentic architecture bridging natural language scientific queries to high-throughput structural bioinformatics pipelines.
tools.weaknesses: Requires multi-backend environment setup and API keys for proprietary endpoints.

tools.name: protein-diffusion-design-lab
tools.usage: protein-diffusion-design-lab is a comprehensive open-source platform inspired by AAAI-25 tutorials and MIT's Boltz-1 release, providing an integrated end-to-end pipeline from structural diffusion generation to sequence design and binding affinity evaluation.
tools.strengths: Clean, modular workflow orchestrating generative backbone diffusion, inverse folding, and Boltz-1 all-atom validation with affinity scoring.
tools.weaknesses: Primarily focused on standard globular protein targets; membrane targets require manual adjustment.

tools.name: protenix-mlx
tools.usage: protenix-mlx is a native Apple Silicon (MLX / Swift) implementation of ByteDance's Protenix (AlphaFold3-class all-atom architecture), featuring int8 quantization and unified memory optimization for local execution on macOS and iOS devices.
tools.strengths: Enables AlphaFold3-class all-atom biomolecular modeling on consumer Apple MacBooks (M1/M2/M3/M4) without discrete server GPUs.
tools.weaknesses: Inference speed on base M-series chips is slower than high-end server GPUs.

tools.name: alphafold-ht
tools.usage: alphafold-ht is an automated high-throughput batch submission and resource management pipeline on GitLab for executing hundreds of AlphaFold jobs seamlessly on Slurm-managed high-performance computing (HPC) clusters.
tools.strengths: Automated dependency chaining separating CPU-heavy MSA generation from GPU structure inference, minimizing GPU idle time.
tools.weaknesses: Specifically configured for Slurm workload managers.

tools.name: mumbo-software
tools.usage: mumbo-software is a specialized biophysical protein design program from the Müller lab that calculates sequence-structure compatibility, side-chain rotamer placement, and multi-state energetic perturbations for protein engineering.
tools.strengths: Accurate electrostatic and van der Waals force field energy scoring complementary to deep learning inverse folding tools.
tools.weaknesses: Computational scaling grows exponentially with larger design window sizes.

tools.name: MD-based-refinement
tools.usage: MD-based-refinement is an automated pipeline on GitLab for systematic molecular dynamics equilibration, solvent relaxation, and energy refinement of AlphaFold-predicted models to resolve steric clashes and optimize crystal packing contacts.
tools.strengths: Automated GROMACS/AMBER setup with explicit solvent boxes and short equilibration that relieves sidechain strains while preserving fold topology.
tools.weaknesses: Requires standard MD engine installations (GROMACS or AMBER).

tools.name: MTJ-Finder2.0
tools.usage: MTJ-Finder2.0 is a specialized structural bioinformatics tool on GitLab designed to detect, classify, and analyze Mortise-Tenon Joint (MTJ) geometric motifs in crystallographic and AlphaFold-predicted protein structures.
tools.strengths: Geometric vector algorithm identifying interlocking secondary structure elements associated with extreme thermal/mechanical stability in hyperthermophilic proteins.
tools.weaknesses: Focused specifically on MTJ topological motifs rather than general fold classification.

tools.name: BoltzGen Demo Space
tools.usage: BoltzGen Demo is an interactive HuggingFace Space showcasing BoltzGen, the generative all-atom framework capable of simultaneously generating protein binder backbones, sidechains, and small-molecule interfaces in an intuitive browser UI.
tools.strengths: Zero-install access to all-atom generative binder design tools with interactive 3D Mol* visualization and downloadable PDB/CIF results.
tools.weaknesses: Execution time is constrained by HuggingFace Space GPU quotas for very large targets.

tools.name: esm3-ppisites Space
tools.usage: esm3-ppisites is a HuggingFace Space developed by Area Science Park that harnesses ESM3 representation embeddings to predict protein-protein interaction (PPI) interface residues and binding hotspots directly from single sequences.
tools.strengths: Rapid zero-shot identification of functional interaction interfaces without requiring time-consuming MSA generation.
tools.weaknesses: Identifies binding propensity but does not output explicit 3D complex coordinates.

tools.name: boltz2-binding-affinity Space
tools.usage: boltz2-binding-affinity is an interactive HuggingFace Space providing a streamlined interface for predicting protein-ligand binding poses and quantitative binding affinity (pKd/pKi) scores powered by Boltz-2 co-folding.
tools.strengths: Accepts protein sequences/PDBs and ligand SMILES directly in the browser to compute calibrated interface energy and ipTM metrics.
tools.weaknesses: Queueing latency on shared HuggingFace hardware during peak usage.

tools.name: ESM-Cambrian 600M
tools.usage: ESM-Cambrian 600M (esm-c-600m) is EvolutionaryScale's open-weights multi-modal protein foundation model hosted on HuggingFace, trained on massive-scale evolutionary sequence and structural diversity to generate high-capacity protein representations.
tools.strengths: Produces dense per-residue embeddings capturing evolutionary conservation, secondary structure, and mutational tolerance with a compact 600M parameter footprint.
tools.weaknesses: Requires downstream heads for explicit 3D coordinate generation.

tools.name: Boltz-2 ONNX
tools.usage: Boltz-2 ONNX model checkpoints on HuggingFace provide converted, quantized, and optimized ONNX Runtime execution graphs with WebGPU and DirectML support for the Boltz-2 all-atom biomolecular structure predictor.
tools.strengths: Fully converted ONNX computation graph supporting mixed precision (FP16 / INT8) and native WebGPU for client-side zero-install in-browser execution.
tools.weaknesses: Slight precision trade-off in highly compressed INT8 quantized branches.

tools.name: ESM3 Playground Space
tools.usage: An interactive HuggingFace Space developed by Colby Ford providing a hands-on playground to explore ESM3 generative multi-modal prompting across sequence, secondary structure, and 3D coordinates.
tools.strengths: Allows users to prompt ESM3 with partial sequence motifs, secondary structure constraints, or active site coordinates with real-time generation.
tools.weaknesses: Runs on the open 1.4B model checkpoint with standard Space queue limitations.

tools.name: reactifpTM
tools.usage: reactifpTM is an open, optimized, and standalone reimplementation of the actifpTM metric for rigorous quality assessment and false-positive filtering in AlphaFold-Multimer protein-protein interaction screens.
tools.strengths: Standalone Python implementation removing complex external dependencies; provides calibrated interface confidence scores taking into account buried surface area and PAE density.
tools.weaknesses: Optimized specifically for AlphaFold-Multimer interfaces; requires adaptations for all-atom ligand docking.

tools.name: ppigFinder
tools.usage: ppigFinder is an integrated cross-platform desktop application designed for microbiologists to perform automated bacterial genome annotation, operon discovery, and AlphaFold 3-based protein-protein interaction screening.
tools.strengths: Intuitive GUI integrating Prokka/Bakta genome annotation with automated AlphaFold 3 batch co-folding and operon co-expression clustering.
tools.weaknesses: Large-scale proteome screens require connection to external GPU compute resources.

tools.name: Medicinal Chemistry Benchmark of AlphaFold 3 & Boltz-2
tools.usage: A comprehensive benchmark rigorously evaluating AlphaFold 3 and Boltz-2 across diverse binding modalities including non-covalent drug-like ligands, covalent inhibitors, macrocycles, peptides, and PROTAC ternary complexes.
tools.strengths: Detailed evaluation of stereochemical plausibility, ligand strain energy, and hydrogen bond geometry across 800+ co-complexes.
tools.weaknesses: Benchmark focuses primarily on crystal structure test sets rather than flexible apo targets.

tools.name: ACER
tools.usage: ACER is an advanced co-folding architecture from the Grisoni Lab designed to overcome out-of-distribution generalization failures in deep learning protein-ligand structural prediction.
tools.strengths: Equivariant graph representation that decouples sequence identity overfitting from 3D geometric complementarity, achieving robust generalizability to novel scaffold chemotypes.
tools.weaknesses: Inference time is slightly higher than standard single-pass docking.

tools.name: CASP16 Practical Outcomes for Biomolecular Prediction
tools.usage: Published in Proteins, this authoritative paper synthesizes the key findings and practical takeaways from the CASP16 experiment for structural biologists and drug discovery researchers across all-atom deep learning models (AlphaFold 3, Chai-1, Boltz-1).
tools.strengths: Authoritative, community-validated benchmark results assessing prediction accuracy on conformational ensembles, disordered regions, and multi-domain assemblies.
tools.weaknesses: Evaluation focuses on blinded targets; does not provide standalone prediction software.

tools.name: PLI Analyzer
tools.usage: PLI Analyzer is an automated computational toolkit for rigorous geometric, physical, and chemical validation of AI-generated protein-ligand and protein-protein interfaces from AlphaFold 3 and Boltz.
tools.strengths: Scores interface plausibility against experimental PDB crystal reference distributions to filter out unphysical hallucinations and steric clashes.
tools.weaknesses: Identifies geometric anomalies but does not recalculate quantum mechanical binding free energies.

tools.name: CAPRI 8th Evaluation Meeting Report
tools.usage: Published in Proteins, this report from the 8th CAPRI Evaluation Meeting reviews the monumental transformation in macromolecular complex prediction brought about by AlphaFold-Multimer and AI co-folding methods.
tools.strengths: Comprehensive evaluation of blind protein-protein and protein-peptide complex predictions from global participants.
tools.weaknesses: Conference evaluation report without downloadable codebase.

tools.name: A Model-Centric Review of Deep Learning for Protein Design
tools.usage: An exhaustive, model-centric survey from the Batista Lab reviewing modern deep learning paradigms for de novo protein design, categorizing sequence language models, structure diffusion models, flow matching, and multi-modal foundation models.
tools.strengths: Systematic taxonomic classification of generative protein architectures with comparative analysis of experimental validation rates.
tools.weaknesses: Broad methodological review without new empirical algorithms.

tools.name: Full-Atom Peptide Flow Matching
tools.usage: This study formulates de novo therapeutic peptide design as joint multi-modal flow matching over 3D full-atom coordinates and discrete sequence tokens conditioned on target protein receptor surfaces.
tools.strengths: Simultaneous continuous flow matching of peptide backbone/sidechain atomic coordinates and categorical sequence generation, eliminating separate inverse folding steps.
tools.weaknesses: Computational complexity increases for cyclic or stapled peptide topologies.

tools.name: Ensemblify
tools.usage: Published in the Journal of Molecular Biology (2026), Ensemblify is a user-friendly platform and toolkit for generating, analyzing, and validating realistic conformational ensembles of intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) and flexible regions.
tools.strengths: Integrates AlphaFold pLDDT disorder metrics, statistical coil models, and experimental SAXS/NMR restraints with automated clustering.
tools.weaknesses: Requires experimental biophysical data (SAXS or NMR) for optimal ensemble reweighting.

tools.name: Influence of Chemical Ligands on AlphaFold 3 Cryptic Pockets
tools.usage: This study from the Vajda and Joseph-McCarthy labs investigates how the inclusion of chemical ligands alters AlphaFold 3 structural predictions to reveal cryptic, transiently open druggable pockets.
tools.strengths: Demonstrates that AlphaFold 3 induces pocket opening when supplied with ligand chemical SMILES, overcoming apo crystal biases.
tools.weaknesses: Hallucinated pocket expansion can occur with oversized non-cognate chemical probes.

tools.name: Protein Structure Prediction Powered by AI Review
tools.usage: Published in Frontiers in Molecular Biosciences (2026), this comprehensive review chronicles the evolution of artificial intelligence in structural biology from early contact prediction to modern all-atom diffusion models.
tools.strengths: In-depth analysis of architectural milestones (Evoformer, Pairformer, invariant point attention, coordinate diffusion) and practical applications in enzymology.
tools.weaknesses: Review article without new software release.

tools.name: Modeling Glycans with AlphaFold 3: Capabilities and Limitations
tools.usage: Published in Glycobiology, this rigorous study assesses AlphaFold 3's capabilities, accuracy, and failure modes when predicting 3D structures of N- and O-linked glycoproteins and complex branched glycan trees.
tools.strengths: Benchmark of AlphaFold 3 predicted glycan torsion angles against high-resolution PDB glycoprotein crystals, establishing guidelines for glycoprotein modeling.
tools.weaknesses: AlphaFold 3 does not fully capture glycan conformational ensembles in solution.

tools.name: Evaluation of AI Approaches for Protein-Aptamer Complex Prediction
tools.usage: Published in Briefings in Bioinformatics (2026), this benchmark evaluates artificial intelligence structural modeling tools on DNA/RNA protein-aptamer complexes, assessing 3D contact fidelity and binding interface prediction.
tools.strengths: Comparative benchmarking of AlphaFold 3, RoseTTAFold2NA, and classic nucleic acid docking algorithms with quantitative interface contact metrics.
tools.weaknesses: Limited availability of high-resolution experimental protein-aptamer crystal structures in public PDB.

tools.name: AntiConf - Antibody-Antigen Confidence Metric
tools.usage: AntiConf is a precision-driven confidence scoring metric specifically calibrated for AI-predicted antibody-antigen complexes to separate true binding paratopes from deceptive false-positive dockings.
tools.strengths: Combines CDR loop local pLDDT, CDR-H3 specific interaction density, and electrostatic complementarity to substantially outperform standard ipTM.
tools.weaknesses: Calibrated primarily for standard IgG formats; requires tuning for camelid nanobodies.

tools.name: AI Agents in Drug Discovery Review
tools.journal: Computer Methods and Programs in Biomedicine
tools.usage: Published in Computer Methods and Programs in Biomedicine (2026), this comprehensive review examines the emergence of autonomous LLM-powered AI agents and multi-agent systems in structural biology and computational drug discovery.
tools.strengths: Analysis of agentic architectures orchestrating protein folding, virtual screening, MD simulation, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.
tools.weaknesses: Survey paper without proprietary software codebase.

tools.name: CABS-flex
tools.usage: Fast simulation of protein structure fluctuations and generation of conformational ensembles from static AlphaFold models via coarse-grained dynamics (equivalent to 10 ns MD in minutes).
tools.strengths: Extremely rapid exploration of backbone flexibility, loop dynamics, and residue-level fluctuations from PDB/AlphaFold inputs without atomistic MD setup.
tools.weaknesses: Coarse-grained force field representation lacks explicit solvent and atomic detail for small-molecule ligand contacts.
tools.github_description: CABS-flex standalone python package for fast simulations of protein flexibility.

citing_papers.title: CABS-flex 2.0: a web server for fast simulations of flexibility of protein structures and protein-protein complexes

tools.name: AF-Sample
tools.usage: Massive conformational sampling of alternative protein states using AlphaFold with increased dropout, random seeds, and perturbed MSA subsampling.
tools.strengths: Discovers hidden conformational states, GPCR active/inactive switches, and large-scale hinge motions with high fidelity.
tools.weaknesses: Requires substantial GPU sampling time across hundreds of prediction seeds.
tools.github_description: AF-Sample: improved AlphaFold sampling with dropout and MSA perturbations.

citing_papers.title: AFsample: improving multimer prediction with AlphaFold using diverse conformations

tools.name: pLDDT (Predicted LDDT)
tools.usage: AlphaFold's primary per-residue confidence metric (0–100 scale), estimating local distance difference test (LDDT-Calpha) against unknown true structures.
tools.strengths: Scores >90 indicate high accuracy with reliable sidechains; 70–90 reliable backbone; <50 strongly correlates with intrinsic disorder (IDRs).
tools.weaknesses: Local metric only; cannot evaluate inter-domain orientations, relative domain packing, or multi-chain quaternary interfaces.
tools.github_description: AlphaFold per-residue confidence metric (Predicted Local Distance Difference Test).

citing_papers.title: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold

tools.name: PAE (Predicted Aligned Error)
tools.usage: N×N residue-pair matrix measuring the expected positional error (in Ångströms, 0–31.75 Å) of residue x when aligned on residue y.
tools.strengths: Indispensable for evaluating relative domain packing, rigid-body motions, and inter-chain binding confidence in multimeric complexes.
tools.weaknesses: Directionally asymmetric; requires careful reading of off-diagonal blocks; small contact patches can sometimes have low PAE even in artifactual assemblies.
tools.github_description: AlphaFold Predicted Aligned Error (PAE) matrix metric.

citing_papers.title: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold

tools.name: pTM / ipTM (Predicted TM-score)
tools.usage: Global structural confidence score (pTM, 0–1) and interface confidence score (ipTM, 0–1) for multimer complexes, combined as 0.8*ipTM + 0.2*pTM for model ranking.
tools.strengths: Effective ranking filter for screening protein-protein interactions; ipTM > 0.8 signifies confident, high-affinity interface.
tools.weaknesses: Can produce false positives for transient or fuzzy interactions; less sensitive to single-point mutations.
tools.github_description: AlphaFold-Multimer interface and global predicted TM-scores (ipTM and pTM).

tools.name: DockQ
tools.usage: Standard continuous quality metric (0–1) for protein-protein docking models and AlphaFold-Multimer interface validation, combining Fnat, LRMS, and iRMS.
tools.strengths: Gold standard benchmark metric in CAPRI; separates incorrect (<0.23), acceptable (0.23–0.49), medium (0.49–0.80), and high quality (>0.80).
tools.weaknesses: Requires an experimental reference structure for ground-truth calculation.
tools.github_description: DockQ - Quality measure for protein-protein docking models.

citing_papers.title: DockQ: A Quality Measure for Protein-Protein Docking Models

tools.name: EMBL-EBI AlphaFold Online Course
tools.usage: Official comprehensive online training course by EMBL-EBI and DeepMind covering protein structure prediction, model interpretation, pLDDT/PAE evaluation, and database navigation.
tools.strengths: Free, modular, accessible walkthroughs of theory, practical tips, ColabFold, experimental validation, and avoiding common pitfalls.
tools.weaknesses: Application-focused; does not teach deep learning model training from scratch.
tools.github_description: AlphaFold: A practical guide to structure prediction by EMBL-EBI and DeepMind.

tools.name: ColabFold & AlphaFold Interactive Workshop
tools.usage: Hands-on educational notebooks, lectures, and slide decks by Sergey Ovchinnikov & Martin Steinegger for running, tweaking, and understanding AlphaFold and ColabFold.
tools.strengths: Interactive Jupyter/Colab notebooks demonstrating MSA subsampling, complex modeling, and batch runs with no local GPU requirement.
tools.weaknesses: Requires basic familiarity with Google Colab and Python.
tools.github_description: ColabFold educational workshops and interactive protein prediction notebooks.

tools.name: AlphaFold 3 Practical Guide & Webinars
tools.usage: Official DeepMind guides, webinars, and educational documentation explaining AlphaFold 3 biomolecular complex modeling (proteins, DNA, RNA, ligands, ions).
tools.strengths: Clear guidelines on input formatting, SMILES/CCD ligands, diffusion confidence metrics, and biological complex design.
tools.weaknesses: Specific to the AlphaFold 3 Server and diffusion architecture.
tools.github_description: DeepMind AlphaFold 3 practical guide, user documentation, and educational webinars.

tools.name: ELIXIR 3D-BioInfo AlphaFold Lectures & Community Webinars
tools.usage: Curated university and community lecture series by ELIXIR 3D-BioInfo and structural biology leaders on AI in structural biology and CASP assessments.
tools.strengths: Rigorous academic lectures on biological interpretation, membrane proteins, docking, and avoiding over-interpretation of predicted models.
tools.weaknesses: Video lectures spanning multiple hours.
tools.github_description: ELIXIR 3D-BioInfo webinar and lecture series on AI-driven structural bioinformatics.

tools.name: SurfDock
tools.usage: SurfDock is an SE(3)-equivariant surface-informed diffusion generative model designed for high-accuracy and reliable protein-ligand complex structure prediction. Unlike conventional coordinate-only docking approaches that ignore solvent-accessible molecular shape or suffer from severe steric clashes, SurfDock explicitly integrates protein molecular surface geometry and electrostatic potential into the diffusion reverse generative process. It demonstrates substantial improvements in blind docking accuracy across PDBbind benchmarks.
tools.strengths: State-of-the-art blind docking accuracy with superior physically valid contact geometry and surface shape complementarity.
tools.weaknesses: Surface mesh computation introduces minor preprocessing overhead compared to pure coordinate point-cloud extractors.

tools.name: protpardelle
